title: Strategic Finance & Operations Manager
description:
About Lula



Lula Commerce is a fast-growing SaaS and marketplace platform for the convenience retail industry. We work with some of the largest convenience chains in the country, along with thousands of independent operators, to run their digital ordering, delivery, and retail data infrastructure.



We run several revenue models at the same time — subscriptions, revenue-share partnerships, GMV-based programs, and project work — and roughly 7,200 billing, payout, and collections items move through the business every month.



Almost all of that is manual today. That is the problem you are here to solve.







The Role



This role has two halves, and we want to be direct about both.



The first half is operational and hands-on. You will run billing, collections, and partner payouts. You will reconcile numbers across Stripe, ACH, Bill.com, partner reports, and our own product data. You will chase overdue accounts and untangle the payout disputes that come with a business this size. For the first stretch, this work will be real, repetitive, and high-volume.



The second half is why we think the right person will want this job. You are expected to systematically eliminate that first half. We want someone who reaches for SQL, Python, Claude Code, and automation tooling by instinct — who looks at a manual reconciliation process and thinks in terms of the script that should be doing it. The measure of success here is how much of your own workload you have automated away, and what you were able to take on with the time you got back.



Underneath both halves is a third expectation: you become the person we come to when a question needs a real answer. Before a partner negotiation, a pricing decision, or a board meeting, we should be able to hand you a messy problem and get back a clear one — here is the data, here is what it says, here is what it means for the business, here is what I would do.



You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CPO, our outsourced accounting team, Sales, and Account Management.



This is a customer-facing role.



We want to be explicit about this, because it is a real part of the job and not an occasional exception.



You will speak with customers and partners directly, and you will represent Finance in those conversations without a founder on the call. In practice, that means handling situations like a multi-store operator telling you their payout is wrong, or that a payment never arrived. You will need to be able to go into the underlying transaction data, figure out what actually happened, and explain it clearly and confidently to someone who is frustrated and whose money is involved.



You will also lead conversations about billing disputes, contract and revenue-share interpretation, overdue balances, and account suspension. Some of these are difficult conversations. We need someone who can hold them calmly, with the numbers in hand.



What you'll own



Billing, collections, and partner payouts - Own invoicing, collections, dunning, failed payments, and account suspension across subscriptions, revenue-share agreements, and project billing. - Own recurring revenue-share and partner payout processing, and resolve discrepancies end to end with customers, partners, and vendors. - Reconcile revenue and payouts across Stripe, ACH, Bill.com, partner reports, and internal systems. - Improve cash collection and give leadership a dependable view of AR.



Automation and systems building - Replace manual, error-prone finance workflows with systems you design and build — using SQL, Python, APIs, AI-enabled tooling, and automation platforms. - Build the exception logic that matters: workflows that flag overdue accounts, catch discrepancies early, and surface only what genuinely needs human judgment. - Create the documentation, controls, and data-quality standards that make complex pricing and partner arrangements repeatable rather than tribal knowledge.



Analysis and decision support - Pull data from multiple systems, clean it, and answer open-ended business questions with it. -Prepare the analysis behind partner negotiations, pricing and packaging decisions, and customer economics — bottom line first, methodology available. - Build and maintain dashboards for ARR, ARPU, ARPS, gross margin, collections, cash, burn, and runway.



Forecasting and reporting - Build and maintain forecasts across subscription, revenue-share, GMV-based, and project revenue, and model customer growth, launch timing, retention, ARPU, gross margin, cash, and runway. - Translate pipeline, contracted stores, live stores, and customer activity into revenue forecasts you can defend. - Compare forecast to actuals, investigate variances, and update assumptions as the business changes. - Prepare monthly leadership and board reporting materials, and support the outsourced accounting team through a timely monthly close



What we're looking for



Roughly 3–6 years across strategic finance, FP&A, finance operations, revenue operations, business operations, or a closely related field.



Working SQL. You can get to data yourself across multiple systems without waiting on anyone.



Real automation experience. Some Python, comfort with APIs, and proficiency with Claude Code or similar AI development tooling. You have built things that removed work permanently, and you can point to them.



Strong financial modeling in Excel or Google Sheets, including building models from scratch.



Genuine comfort with messy source data — the ability to investigate inconsistencies and reach a well-supported answer rather than an approximate one.



Startup experience, ideally Seed through Series B, in SaaS, marketplace, ecommerce, delivery, restaurant tech, logistics, or fintech.



Strong ownership and urgency. You communicate early, meet commitments, and keep work moving without repeated follow-up.



The ability to explain financial information clearly to people who don't work in finance — including customers.



Helpful, not required: revenue-share, GMV, or multi-sided marketplace models; Stripe, Bill.com, QuickBooks, or NetSuite; BI tooling; US GAAP and SaaS revenue recognition



What success looks like



In your first few months, billing, collections, and partner payouts are accurate and consistent, and leadership has a reliable view of revenue, cash, runway, and unit economics.



By six months, a meaningful share of the manual work you inherited is running on systems you built, and discrepancies surface before anyone outside the company notices them.



Most importantly, you become the person who can take an ambiguous financial or operational question, find the right data, determine the answer, and build a repeatable process around it.



Why Lula



You will work directly with company leadership, with unusual visibility into how a multi-revenue-model business actually works, and with the freedom to rebuild how Finance and Business Operations function as we scale. If you like bringing order to complexity and building systems that make yesterday's problems disappear, we would like to hear from you.



We are remote-first. You will be asked to come to our Cherry Hill, NJ office occasionally — roughly once every few months.

title: Engagement Operations Manager

Manage the principal’s inbox, prioritising
s, flagging important matters, and drafting responses where appropriate.

Maintain the principal’s calendar, coordinate appointments, and manage scheduling changes.

Maintain organised records of payments, invoices, and outstanding items.

Follow established administrative and financial processes, escalating discrepancies or issues to the appropriate person.

Maintain accurate records and ensure tasks are completed within agreed timeframes.

Work independently with minimal supervision while keeping the principal informed of progress, risks, and matters requiring decisions.



Skills and Experience



Essential Requirements



Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and courteously with clients, lawyers, and other stakeholders.

Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple matters, deadlines, and follow-up actions simultaneously.

Strong administrative and coordination skills, including document management, recordkeeping, scheduling, and
 management.

Confidence in learning and using new software, online systems, and AI-powered tools.

Ability to follow documented procedures accurately and consistently.

Strong initiative and problem-solving skills, with the judgement to work independently and escalate issues appropriately.

A proactive, dependable, and service-oriented approach to work.

Ability to work full-time during Sydney business hours.



Desirable Experience



Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Client Services Coordinator, or in a similar administrative role.

Experience coordinating client engagements, professional services matters, legal administration, or document-heavy workflows.

Familiarity with AI tools for drafting, document preparation, research, or administrative automation.

Experience managing customer enquiries, onboarding, or service delivery workflows.

Exposure to invoicing, receipts, or coordination with a bookkeeper.



Experience in property valuation, finance, or accounting is not required.



What Success Looks Like



Valuation matters progress smoothly from engagement through to final report delivery, with deadlines and outstanding requirements consistently monitored.

Clients and lawyers receive timely, professional communication and know what is required at each stage.

Draft documents are prepared accurately using established templates and AI tools, with key outputs submitted for review.

You'll work closely with the team to manage customer enquiries, coordinate deliveries, maintain accurate records, support inventory management, and assist with general e-commerce administration.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, take initiative, and follow tasks through to completion without needing constant supervision.



This is an opportunity to become a valued, long-term member of a growing business, with the potential for your hours to increase as the business expands.

1. Customer Service & Order Support



Respond to customer enquiries via

title: Track & Trace – Quality Assurance Team Lead (Brokerage Operations)
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven Track & Trace Quality Assurance Team Lead to oversee our QA operations, lead a team of remote associates, and ensure every booked load is properly verified before pickup. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong US freight brokerage experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment.



If you have experience managing logistics operations, identifying freight fraud risks, resolving escalations, and driving team performance, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, GH Logistics books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads.



As the Quality Assurance Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the team's daily workload, monitoring verification progress, reviewing operational accuracy, and ensuring that no critical verification steps are overlooked. You will serve as the primary point of escalation for unresolved driver verification issues, suspicious carrier activity, tracking discrepancies, and operational concerns that could affect pickup performance or shipment security.



Beyond supervising the team, you are expected to remain actively involved in operations, make timely decisions, identify process gaps, and ensure consistent execution of established SOPs. This is a working leadership role, not solely an administrative or supervisory position. You must be comfortable stepping into operational tasks, handling difficult situations, and taking ownership of your team's results.



What You'll Be Doing



Team Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and supervise the Quality Assurance team, ensuring all assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• Distribute workloads based on shipment volume, urgency, team capacity, and operational priorities.

• Monitor individual and team productivity, task completion, verification accuracy, and overall performance.

• Ensure team members consistently follow established SOPs, verification procedures, and documentation standards.

• Provide real-time guidance, coaching, and corrective feedback to improve individual and team performance.

• Identify performance gaps, recurring errors, and accountability concerns, and escalate them to management when necessary.

• Maintain clear shift handovers, ensuring pending verifications, unresolved issues, and critical follow-ups are properly communicated.

• Take ownership of daily QA execution and ensure operational priorities are completed without unnecessary delays.



Load Verification, Quality Control & Fraud Prevention

• Oversee the verification process for booked loads, ensuring rate confirmations are sent to the correct carriers.

• Ensure driver information, carrier details, and load assignments are complete, accurate, and properly documented.

• Review CDL verification results and ensure required identity verification procedures are followed.

• Monitor compliance with driver check calls, tracking assignments, and pre-pickup verification requirements.

• Conduct quality checks and spot audits to identify incomplete verifications, documentation errors, and procedural violations.

• Investigate inconsistencies involving driver identities, carrier information, contact numbers, and shipment assignments.

• Identify potential freight fraud, identity mismatches, double-brokering indicators, and other suspicious activities.

• Immediately escalate high-risk concerns to Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management.

• Ensure questionable or unverified assignments are escalated and appropriately resolved before freight movement.



Escalation Management & Operational Decision-Making

• Serve as the first point of escalation for QA associates handling complex or unresolved verification issues.

• Investigate discrepancies between rate confirmations, TMS records, carrier instructions, driver information, and shipment documents.

• Make timely, informed decisions within established authority and escalate matters requiring management approval.

• Coordinate with Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, and Operations to resolve verification delays, missing information, and potential service failures.

• Prioritize urgent operational concerns based on fraud risk, pickup deadlines, shipment impact, and customer requirements.

• Ensure unresolved issues are properly documented, assigned, and followed through until resolution.

• Communicate critical i
 to management with clear findings, actions taken, and recommended next steps.



Driver Coordination & Tracking Oversight

• Ensure assigned drivers are contacted and properly informed of pickup and delivery details, appointment times, and equipment requirements.

• Oversee the accuracy of driver information entered into the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Monitor GPS tracking assignments and ensure tracking readiness before scheduled pickups.

• Ensure CDL verification links are sent and outstanding requirements are followed up on promptly.

• Verify that team-driver assignments meet the required confirmation procedures.

• Step in to conduct driver or dispatcher calls when necessary to resolve urgent issues or support the team.

• Ensure no assigned load is overlooked due to incomplete follow-ups or unclear ownership.



Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track daily QA performance, including load verification completion, documentation accuracy, outstanding requirements, and unresolved escalations.

• Monitor individual productivity and identify associates who require additional coaching or support.

• Prepare clear operational updates and performance reports for management.

• Review recurring verification errors, missed follow-ups, and operational bottlenecks.

• Recommend improvements to workflows, verification procedures, and quality control processes.

• Support onboarding and training of new QA associates to ensure they understand operational expectations and SOPs.

• Promote a culture of accuracy, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.



What Success Looks Like

• All assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• QA associates consistently complete required verification steps accurately and on time.

• Driver information, CDL verification, tracking assignments, and check calls are properly documented.

• Potential freight fraud indicators are identified early and escalated immediately.

• High-risk or unresolved verification issues are not overlooked or allowed to progress without appropriate action.

• Workloads are distributed fairly and effectively, and the team consistently meets operational deadlines.

• Individual performance is monitored, and recurring errors are addressed through coaching and accountability.

• Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management have clear visibility into verification progress and outstanding concerns.

• Shift handovers are organized, with no critical tasks left without ownership.

• QA processes become more consistent, efficient, and reliable under your leadership.



Who We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a US freight brokerage, trucking carrier, or third-party logistics (3PL) company, preferably in Track & Trace, carrier operations, dispatch, or logistics quality assurance.

• Previous experience as a Team Lead, Senior QA Associate, Operations Supervisor, or similar leadership role is strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, including driver assignments, pickup and delivery appointments, equipment requirements, and CDL verification.

• Familiarity with freight fraud prevention, carrier verification, and operational risk management.

• Experience using Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and GPS tracking platforms such as FourKites, Samsara, or MacroPoint.

• Proven ability to manage workloads, monitor team performance, and maintain operational accountability.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to make decisions under pressure.

• Ability to investigate conflicting information, identify operational risks, and determine appropriate escalation actions.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including confidence communicating with US-based drivers, dispatchers, and operational leadership.

• Comfortable handling outbound calls, difficult conversations, and urgent operational escalations.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to coach team members, provide constructive feedback, and address performance concerns professionally.

• High attention to detail, strong ownership, and a proactive approach to operational challenges.

• Minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Work Setup & Schedule

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Schedule: Sunday - Thursday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time | Tuesday - Saturday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Leadership Experience: Take ownership of team performance, operational quality, and daily execution.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help prevent freight fraud, protect shipments, improve operational accuracy, and strengthen team performance.

• Structured Workflows: Established SOPs, clear expectations, and opportunities to contribute to process improvements.



Ready to Apply?



Freight fraud prevention and operational accuracy are critical to the success of our business. We're looking for a leader who can do more than supervise a team, someone who can take ownership, make sound decisions, hold people accountable, and ensure every verification is completed correctly.



If you're an experienced US logistics professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex operational problems, and knows how to lead a team toward consistent results, we'd like to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Visit Us:

title: Reporting Analyst
description:
Position Summary

Amada Senior Care – East Bay is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and technically proficient Reporting Analyst to support operational reporting, performance monitoring, data management, dashboard development, and selected business process automation projects.



The role will focus on ensuring that company leadership has access to accurate, timely, and actionable information to evaluate business performance, identify operational gaps, monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and support data-driven decision-making.



In addition to regular reporting responsibilities, the Reporting Analyst may support specialized technical projects, including workflow automation and the development of an automated lead-response and call-routing system.



The position will initially operate under a flexible, hourly, project-based arrangement, with the potential to transition into a full-time role depending on business needs, workload, and individual performance.



2. Key Responsibilities



A.	Data Collection and Reporting



•	Collect, consolidate, organize, and maintain operational data from various departments and reporting platforms.

•	Prepare and update daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, and ad hoc operational reports as assigned.

•	Ensure that reports are accurate, complete, consistent, and submitted within established deadlines.

•	Maintain organized reporting databases, spreadsheets, historical records, and supporting documentation.

•	Identify discrepancies, missing information, and inconsistencies across data sources.

•	Coordinate with relevant departments to validate reporting information and resolve data issues.

•	Ensure that reports are presented in a clear and understandable format for management review.

•	Ensure that dashboard formulas, filters, reporting periods, and data references are accurate and functioning properly.

•	Troubleshoot spreadsheet errors, formula inconsistencies, and reporting discrepancies.

•	Maintain standardized KPI definitions and calculation methodologies.

•	Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting processes and reduce manual work.

•	Continuously improve dashboard functionality, usability, and reporting efficiency.

title: VIDEO EDITOR – DTC Ecom
description:
We are looking for a Video Editor to help scale the performance creative engine of a fast-growing DTC beauty & personal care brand primarily serving the US market.



This role is responsible for turning creative briefs into high-performing video ads across Meta and TikTok, including UGC ads, product demonstrations, AI-generated creatives, iterations of winning concepts, and new creative experiments.



We are looking for someone who understands direct-response advertising, consumer psychology, and performance creative — not just video editing.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit high-performing video ads based on creative briefs, including UGC, product demos, storytelling ads, and AI-generated creatives

• Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to turn concepts, hooks, and scripts into engaging performance assets

• Create iterations of winning ads by improving hooks, pacing, visuals, storytelling, and overall execution based on performance insights

• Develop AI-generated video content using tools such as AI avatars, AI scenes, AI animation, voiceovers, and AI-assisted editing workflows

• Maintain strong visual quality, brand consistency, and alignment with the creative strategy

• Continuously improve editing workflows to increase creative testing speed and output quality



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience editing performance ads for DTC brands

• Experience in beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care is a strong plus

• Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising formats and what makes ads convert

• Experience using AI-generated content and AI creative tools

• Ability to understand a creative brief and independently translate strategy into compelling visuals

• Strong attention to detail in pacing, storytelling, shot selection, visual logic, and overall ad quality

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with frequent creative iterations



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your portfolio link and CV

2. Have you worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands? If so, please specify the brand names and specify your role and length of experience.

4. Your current availability/start date

5. Your expected monthly salary

6. A short note on the editing tools and AI tools you use

7. From a clear brief and provided raw footage, how many finished 30–60 second ad can you normally produce in one day?

8. For a 1-minute video, how long does it usually take you to re-edit the video after receiving revision feedback?

9. How many years have you been a full-time video editor?

10. Which types of performance ad creatives are you strongest at editing, and which are you less confident with? Please list them separately (e.g., UGC, product demos, testimonials, storytelling ads, AI-generated creatives etc).

11. Are you currently working with any other clients or companies? Looking for fractional or full-time?



Applications that do not follow the requested format may not be considered.

title: Editor for UGC Videos
description:

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.

Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Part-Time Real Estate Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) – Rental Properties
description:
About us

US-based real estate investor and private lender with a portfolio of rental properties. Our systems are already organized: bank and credit card feeds sync to QuickBooks Online, each property has its own bank account, and properties are tracked by class. We need a skilled bookkeeper to keep the books clean every week.



What you’ll do



Review and categorize transactions in QuickBooks Online every week

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

Record rental income, mortgage payments (including principal/interest/escrow splits), and property expenses to the correct property

Send a short weekly list of any transactions you’re unsure about

Deliver a weekly P&L and Balance Sheet



Hours: 5–8 hours per week to start. Flexible schedule, but the weekly review must be completed by an agreed day every week. If you’re excellent, this can grow into full-time work that includes administrative tasks.



Requirements



Strong accounting skills, with real estate or property management bookkeeping experience

Proficient in QuickBooks Online (QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred)

Understanding of rental property accounting: repairs vs. capital improvements, mortgage splits, security deposits

Clear, confident spoken and written English

Highly reliable. You meet every deadline and communicate before a problem, not after.

Accurate and detail-oriented

Self-directed: you make sound decisions independently and ask questions only when it truly matters



How to apply

Use the subject line: “Weekly Books – [your years of QuickBooks experience] – Real Estate”



In your application, include:



Your real estate or property management bookkeeping experience

Your QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification link, if you have one

A 2–3 minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself in English



Applications that don’t follow these instructions will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid bookkeeping test.

Job Title: NetSuite Administrator

Work Setup: Remote / Offshore

Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time



Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced NetSuite Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize the organization’s NetSuite ERP platform. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in NetSuite administration, user support, configuration, reporting, and system optimization. This role will work closely with finance, operations, and other business teams to ensure NetSuite effectively supports business processes and requirements.



Key Responsibilities

-Administer and maintain the NetSuite ERP platform, including users, roles, permissions, workflows, and dashboards.

-Configure NetSuite based on business and operational requirements.

-Manage user access, security roles, permissions, and system preferences.

-Create and maintain saved searches, reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

-Support and troubleshoot NetSuite-related issues and provide timely resolution.

-Develop and maintain workflows, custom fields, forms, and other system configurations.

-Assist with NetSuite integrations and third-party applications.

-Support data imports, exports, updates, and data quality initiatives.

-Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Operations, IT, and other stakeholders to improve business processes.

-Assist with system testing, upgrades, releases, and new functionality.

-Maintain system documentation, procedures, and configuration records.

-Provide training and technical support to NetSuite users when needed.



Qualifications

-3+ years of hands-on NetSuite administration experience.

-Strong knowledge of NetSuite ERP functionality and configuration.

-Experience managing NetSuite users, roles, permissions, and security.

-Proficiency with Saved Searches, Reports, Dashboards, and KPIs.

-Experience creating and managing NetSuite workflows, custom fields, forms, and records.

-Knowledge of NetSuite modules such as Financials, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory, or CRM.

-Experience with data imports/exports and data cleansing.

-Familiarity with NetSuite integrations and APIs is preferred.

-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-Good understanding of business processes, particularly accounting and finance workflows.

-Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

-Ability to work independently in a remote environment.



Preferred Qualifications

-NetSuite Certified Administrator or relevant NetSuite certification.

-Experience with SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, or SuiteTalk.

-Experience supporting NetSuite implementations, migrations, or optimization projects.

-Experience working with international or US-based clients.

title: EXPERIENCED U.S. BANKRUPTCY PARALEGAL / LEGAL ASSISTANT (CHAPTER 7)
description:
Remote | Philippines | Independent Contractor | $10 to $17 USD/hour | 30+ Hours/Week | Flexible Schedule



ABOUT US



The Brown Law Firm is a growing U.S. bankruptcy practice with offices in Victoria and Dripping Springs, Texas. Our Chapter 7 case preparation team is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced bankruptcy paralegal or legal assistant to prepare petition drafts for attorney review.



This position requires substantial hands-on experience preparing U.S. bankruptcy petitions. Onboarding covers our firm's systems and procedures and the local rules and procedures of the Southern and Western Districts of Texas; it does not include instruction in bankruptcy fundamentals.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



All work is performed under the direct supervision of our U.S.-licensed attorney, who reviews and approves every petition before it is presented to the client or filed.



- Prepare Chapter 7 petition drafts, including schedules, statements, means test calculations, and supporting documentation, for attorney review.

- Review and reconcile client financial records, including tax returns, pay stubs, bank statements, assets, debts, income, expenses, and creditor information.

- Flag discrepancies, missing documentation, incomplete disclosures, and issues requiring attorney judgment.

- Communicate with U.S. clients to collect documents, clarify facts, and provide case status updates. Legal questions from clients are referred to the attorney.

- Manage multiple cases at different stages of preparation and proactively follow up on outstanding information.

- Maintain accurate case notes, statuses, and task records in our case management system.

- Collaborate with the attorney and other firm staff to ensure petitions are accurate, complete, and ready for attorney review.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing U.S. bankruptcy petitions, preferably Chapter 7. Chapter 11 and Chapter 13 experience will also be considered.

- Working knowledge of bankruptcy schedules, statements, means testing, financial disclosures, and supporting documentation.

- Ability to prepare complete or substantially complete bankruptcy petition drafts without extensive technical guidance.

- Previous experience communicating directly with U.S. legal clients, including document collection, clarification of financial information, and case follow-up.

- Excellent written and spoken English for direct communication with American clients.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Proficiency with cloud software, PDF tools, digital document management, and remote collaboration.

- Commitment to confidentiality, professional judgment, and ethical legal support practices.



HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Fluency in Latin American Spanish, particularly the ability to communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients. This is a major advantage.

- Experience preparing Texas bankruptcy cases, including familiarity with Texas exemptions and procedures in the Southern and Western Districts of Texas.

- Experience with Jubilee, Best Case, NextChapter, or comparable bankruptcy preparation software.

- Hands-on experience using PACER to research bankruptcy dockets and case records. CM/ECF familiarity is an additional advantage.

- Previous experience working for a U.S. bankruptcy law firm.

- A Philippine law degree, Philippine Bar examination passage, or active Philippine attorney licensure. This is valued, but it does not replace U.S. bankruptcy experience.

- Experience managing substantial caseloads and meeting consistent production expectations.



PRODUCTIVITY & PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Once established, our target is an average of 3 to 5 accurate, attorney-ready bankruptcy petitions per week for cases with complete documentation.



We understand that bankruptcy preparation is a multistage process involving document collection, financial review, client follow-up, verification, and attorney review. Case complexity and client responsiveness vary.



We do not expect an entire bankruptcy case to be completed in a single day.



We are looking for someone who can manage multiple cases at different stages, maintain consistent progress, identify problems early, follow up reliably, and produce accurate drafts for attorney review.



We value accuracy, accountability, proactive communication, and consistent results.



SCHEDULE AND COMMUNICATION



- We are seeking someone who can commit at least 30 hours per week of availability. Our current case volume supports full-time hours, and additional hours are available when workload permits. Paid hours are not guaranteed and depend on available work.

- No fixed Monday through Friday, 9-to-5 schedule. You may work evenings, overnight hours, or weekends.

- Our communication window is 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM U.S. Central Time. You will agree on regular overlapping availability for client calls, discussions with the attorney, and team coordination.

- Outside these communication requirements, you have substantial flexibility to determine when you perform your work.

- Working time is recorded against assigned tasks in our case management system. Accurate, real-time task-based time tracking is required and is used to calculate payment.



COMPENSATION



$10 to $17 USD per hour, based on experience, demonstrated skill, Texas bankruptcy experience, and Spanish proficiency.



Paid weekly via Wise.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- A reliable computer capable of handling large PDFs, cloud-based systems, and video calls.

- High-speed primary internet AND an independent backup connection, such as a secondary ISP or mobile hotspot.

- Backup power capable of supporting essential work equipment for at least 2 to 4 hours.

- A quiet, private workspace suitable for confidential client calls.

- Ability to use individual logins, secure systems, and multifactor authentication.

- A contingency plan for extended power or internet interruptions.



ONBOARDING AND GROWTH



Onboarding focuses on applying your existing bankruptcy preparation experience within our firm's systems, workflows, quality standards, and attorney review procedures. An assigned point of contact will be available for questions during the initial onboarding period.



We value professional development and continuous improvement, and we welcome experienced candidates who are willing to learn and adapt.



As our Chapter 7 department grows, contractors who demonstrate consistent quality, sound judgment, and leadership capabilities may be considered for additional responsibilities in quality review, staff training, workflow improvement, or future supervisory opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your resume and provide specific answers to the following questions.



1. BANKRUPTCY EXPERIENCE



How many years have you prepared U.S. bankruptcy petitions? Which chapters have you worked with, and approximately how many petitions have you personally prepared?



2. INDEPENDENT PETITION PREPARATION



Which portions of a Chapter 7 petition can you draft without technical guidance? Have you prepared complete petition drafts, including schedules, statements, and means tests, for attorney review?



3. BANKRUPTCY SOFTWARE



Which bankruptcy preparation programs have you used? Describe your experience with PACER and CM/ECF.



4. TEXAS BANKRUPTCY EXPERIENCE



Have you previously worked on bankruptcy cases filed in Texas? If so, which federal judicial districts? How familiar are you with Texas exemptions and local court procedures?



5. PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE



What was your typical caseload in your previous position? Approximately how many petitions did you complete for attorney review each week?



6. CASE MANAGEMENT



If you had 12 active bankruptcy cases at different stages of preparation, how would you organize your workload to consistently produce 3 to 5 attorney-ready petitions per week?



7. CLIENT FOLLOW-UP AND CASE OWNERSHIP



You have a Chapter 7 case that is nearly ready for attorney review, but the client has not provided two necessary documents despite previous requests. What steps would you take, and how would you document and communicate the situation?



8. FINANCIAL DISCREPANCIES



Describe a time you identified and resolved a discrepancy in a client's financial information. What was the issue, and how did you handle it?



9. PROFESSIONAL JUDGMENT



A bankruptcy client asks whether they should keep their vehicle or surrender it. How would you respond?



10. LEGAL EDUCATION AND LICENSURE



Do you hold a Philippine law degree? Have you passed the Philippine Bar examination, and are you currently licensed to practice law in the Philippines?



11. SPANISH PROFICIENCY



Describe your Spanish proficiency, if any, including experience communicating with Spanish-speaking clients.



12. WORK AVAILABILITY



How many hours per week do you currently work, and for which other clients or employers? How many hours can you commit to our firm, and what overlapping availability can you offer during 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM U.S. Central Time?



13. TECHNICAL INFRASTRUCTURE



Describe your primary internet connection, backup internet connection, and backup power arrangements. Approximately how long can your essential equipment remain operational during a power outage?



14. COMPENSATION EXPECTATIONS



What hourly rate are you seeking?



IMPORTANT APPLICATION NOTICE



Substantial hands-on experience preparing U.S. bankruptcy petitions is required.



Applicants whose experience consists solely of general legal assistance, formal legal education, or unrelated legal practice without actual U.S. bankruptcy petition preparation experience will not meet the minimum qualifications.



Please provide specific responses demonstrating your bankruptcy experience, technical proficiency, and ability to manage cases effectively.



We look forward to hearing from experienced professionals interested in a flexible opportunity with a growing American law firm.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Job Summary:

The Accounting Officer manages Consilium Labs’ day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate

financial records, timely invoicing and collections, disciplined expense management, reliable reporting,

and effective financial controls. The role supports leadership with clear financial visibility while helping

protect profitability, cash flow, and operational discipline.



Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Bank Management & Payments

● Manage and monitor company bank accounts, including daily balances, transactions, transfers,

and account activity.

● Review and process approved vendor, employee, tax, and other company payments in

accordance with established approval procedures.

● Schedule and coordinate payments to ensure obligations are paid accurately and on time.

● Maintain visibility into upcoming payment obligations and available cash balances to support

short-term cash-flow planning.

● Prepare payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals and supporting documentation are

obtained before payments are processed.

● Maintain payment records, bank confirmations, remittance information, and other supporting

documentation.

● Monitor recurring payments and upcoming obligations and escalate potential cash-flow concerns

or payment issues to leadership.

● Coordinate with banks and payment providers regarding account maintenance, transaction

issues, access, and required documentation.

● Investigate unusual or unauthorized transactions and promptly escalate material issues.

2. Billing & Accounts Receivable



● Prepare and issue accurate client invoices on time based on approved contracts, billing

schedules, and supporting information.

● Assist with billing setup for new contracts and maintain accurate billing information in relevant

systems.

● Monitor accounts-receivable aging reports and follow up professionally on overdue balances.

● Maintain accurate payment records, remittance tracking, and collection documentation.

● Maintain accurate accounts-receivable aging and promptly investigate billing or payment

discrepancies.

● Alert leadership to significant collection risks or overdue balances.

3. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

● Review vendor invoices, payment approvals, vendor files, and payment history for accuracy and

completeness.

● Process and schedule vendor payments only after required approvals have been obtained.

● Maintain accurate accounts-payable aging and visibility into upcoming vendor obligations.

● Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records and payment information.

● Ensure expenses are properly coded, documented, and recorded in the accounting system.

● Investigate discrepancies between invoices, payment records, and accounting records.

4. Accounting & Reconciliations

● Maintain accurate and complete accounting records and supporting documentation.

● Perform monthly bank, credit-card, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

● Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies in a timely manner.

● Maintain consistency and data integrity across accounting, invoicing, payment, and related

billing systems.

● Support a timely and accurate month-end close process.

● Ensure transactions are properly classified and recorded in accordance with company accounting

procedures.

5. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting

● Coordinate the financial processing of payroll with payroll providers based on employee and

payroll changes provided and approved by the appropriate parties.

● Maintain commission schedules, bonus tracking, reimbursement logs, and year-end payroll

documentation based on approved inputs from department owners and management.

● Ensure payroll-related accounting entries and supporting documentation are accurate and

complete.

6. Financial Reporting & Cash Flow

● Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, margins, collections, and

cash balances.

● Support budget-versus-actual reporting and investigate significant variances.

● Maintain visibility into expected cash inflows, upcoming payment obligations, and short-term

cash-flow requirements.

● Provide management with timely financial information and escalate material cash-flow,

overspending, margin, collection, or other financial risks.

● Identify unusual transactions or financial trends that require management attention.



7. Month-End, Tax & External Support

● Support the month-end close by ensuring required transactions, reconciliations, and supporting

schedules are completed accurately and on time.

● Maintain organized records for audits, tax filings, insurance requirements, regulatory requests,

and other financial documentation.

● Support external CPAs, tax preparers, auditors, and other financial advisors by providing

requested records and information.

● Assist with year-end accounting and tax-related documentation as required.

8. Finance Systems, Processes & Controls

● Maintain accurate and consistent information across accounting, invoicing, banking, payment,

and related financial systems.

● Assist with billing setup, vendor onboarding, and payment-system administration.

● Identify opportunities to improve finance workflows, controls, processes, and automation.

● Support implementation and maintenance of procedures designed to improve accuracy,

efficiency, and visibility.

● Promptly investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial systems and source

documentation.

title: Senior BPO Operations Lead & Supplier Onboarding Specialist (UK Shift)
description:
Role Title: Senior BPO Operations & Supplier Onboarding Lead (Player-Coach)

Location: Philippines (100% Remote / Work from Home with Co-Working Support)

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM UK Time (5:00 PM – 2:00 AM Manila Time / Mid-Shift)



How to Apply (Mandatory Application Instructions)



To be considered for this senior leadership role, please submit your application with the following three items:



Updated Resume / CV highlighting your previous BPO team management experience, headcount managed (50–150+ staff), and property/marketplace/ uk client background.



Voice Recording (1 to 2 Minutes): Provide a link (via Vocaroo, Google Drive, Loom, or MP3 link) to a 1–2 minute voice recording answering:



"Introduce yourself, summarize your experience managing operations teams (50–150+ staff) and building customer support workflows, and explain why you are confident picking up the phone to chase UK trade contractors for missing compliance documents."



Professional References: Provide 2–3 professional references (at least 1 former direct supervisor/manager) with name, title, company,
, and LinkedIn profile.



*Applications submitted without a voice recording link and professional references will not be reviewed.



Recruitment & Practical Assessment Process



Our hiring process is rigorous to ensure we select a top-tier BPO leader capable of managing both hands-on execution and high-level strategy:



Stage 1 — Application Screening: Resume, voice recording, and reference audit.



Stage 2 — First Interview (Initial Screening & Spoken English Audit): 30-minute video interview focusing on team management, BPO metrics, and phone confidence.



Stage 3 — Practical Business Case / Practical Exam (Take-Home Assessment): Qualified candidates will complete a short, 45-minute practical business case assessment simulating real-world marketplace operations:

Task A (Supplier Chasing Strategy): Draft an outbound phone script and
 follow-up sequence to chase an unresponsive plumber for missing Public Liability Insurance.

Task B (Process & SOP Architecture): Outline a step-by-step customer support workflow for handling an urgent property maintenance escalation (e.g., supplier no-show for a leaking pipe).

Task C (Team Scaling Plan): Briefly detail a plan for interviewing, onboarding, and training 2 junior dispatch agents as job volumes scale.



Stage 4 — Final Leadership Interview: Deep-dive review of the business case submission and final alignment with UK Executive Leadership.



Stage 5 — Reference Check & Offer: Formal verification of previous employment and reference checks prior to contract issuing.

3 Core Skills Required for This Role



1. BPO Operations Leadership, Team Hiring & Process Architecture (50–150+ Team Management)

Proven expertise in building, designing, and governing BPO operations and B2B customer support workflows from scratch (Zendesk/Freshdesk SOPs, SLAs, ticketing structures, and CSAT tracking). Demonstrated track record in sourcing, interviewing, hiring, and managing offshore support teams as transaction volumes scale.



2. High-Volume Outbound Phone Communication & Contractor Chasing

Exceptional, assertive, and professional spoken English (neutral accent) with strong confidence in making proactive outbound calls to UK trade contractors (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths). Ability to chase missing compliance documents (insurance, bank/VAT details) and convince suppliers to accept unallocated marketplace jobs at set rate cards.



3. B2B Marketplace & Property Maintenance Systems Management

Hands-on proficiency with cloud telephony/VoIP tools (Aircall, RingCentral), CRM/helpdesk platforms, and property management/dispatch software (Fixflo, Reapit, or similar ERPs) to manage real-time work order allocation and maintain supplier compliance databases.



About the Role



We are a fast-growing UK-based B2B marketplace connecting property managers with qualified maintenance service suppliers and trade contractors. We are looking for an exceptionally qualified, strategic, and proven Senior BPO Operations & Supplier Onboarding Lead to establish, govern, and scale our core operational, marketplace, and customer support engine from the Philippines.



This is a high-impact, "Player-Coach" leadership role with direct recruitment and team-expansion responsibility. Designed for a seasoned BPO operations manager who has successfully led large-scale teams (50 to 150+ personnel), this position empowers you to build our offshore operations hub from the ground up. In the initial setup phase, you will directly execute core operational functions—building customer support workflows, onboarding maintenance suppliers, chasing compliance documentation, and allocating unallocated jobs. As transaction volumes expand, you will actively recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and lead a dedicated team of junior dispatch and customer support agents, stepping into a full departmental managerial role.



Key Responsibilities



1. Team Hiring, Expansion & Departmental Leadership

Recruitment & Talent Sourcing: Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts in the Philippines (screening resumes, interviewing candidates, and conducting skill assessments) to hire junior support, dispatch, and document vetting agents as job volumes scale.



Team Onboarding & Training: Develop and deliver comprehensive onboarding, training modules, and call/ticket shadowing programs for all new Philippine hires.



Direct Team Management & Coaching: Provide day-to-day supervision, KPI tracking, performance reviews, and active mentoring to foster a high-performing offshore support team.



Capacity & Workforce Planning: Monitor interaction/ticket volumes to forecast staffing needs and trigger headcount expansion in alignment with UK leadership.



2. Marketplace Customer Support Architecture & Process Engineering



Build & Architect Marketplace Support Processes: Design, establish, and document end-to-end two-sided support workflows (for both Property Managers and Service Suppliers), ticketing structures, escalation pathways, and service level agreements (SLAs) from the ground up.



SOP & Knowledge Base Creation: Develop comprehensive B2B Customer Support Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), call/email scripts, canned responses, macro templates, and self-service help center knowledge bases.



Operational Governance & Analytics: Establish and track core BPO and marketplace metrics (Customer CSAT/NPS, First-Contact Resolution, Ticket Response Times, Supplier Onboarding Turnaround, Job Match Rates, and Quality Audit Scores).



Strategic Executive Reporting: Provide strategic operational reporting, team performance data, marketplace liquidity insights, and risk management assessments directly to UK executive leadership.



3. B2B Supplier Network Onboarding & Compliance Management



Strategically oversee and drive the onboarding pipeline for UK trade contractors and maintenance service suppliers (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, HVAC specialists).



Enforce strict compliance auditing for Public Liability Insurance, tax/VAT details, bank credentials, and professional trade certifications.



Proactively engage suppliers via outbound calls and strategic follow-ups to resolve compliance bottlenecks, guide profile creation, and accelerate registration turnaround times.



Oversee supplier training and adoption across our B2B platform, ensuring trade contractors accept jobs, update statuses, and complete work orders via mobile web/apps.



4. Marketplace Job Allocation, Dispatch & High-Level Escalations



Maintain active oversight of property management portals and marketplace queues to eliminate unallocated maintenance backlogs and response bottlenecks.



Drive contractor allocation strategies, proactively contacting panel suppliers to inform them of available work orders and secure job acceptance at set rate cards.



Serve as the primary hands-on point of contact for complex Property Manager and Service Supplier queries, handling inbound phone calls,
s, and tickets with flawless resolution.



Oversee emergency repair workflows, vendor no-shows, and priority SLA breaches during UK business hours.



Candidate Requirements & Qualifications



Core Required Skills & Profile



Skill 1 — Large-Team BPO Leadership, Recruitment & Process Architecture: Proven track record managing teams of 50 to 150+ personnel as an Operations Manager, Senior Team Lead, or Delivery Lead within a BPO/contact center/marketplace environment supporting UK clients, with demonstrated experience in interviewing, hiring staff, and building customer support workflows/SOPs from scratch.



Skill 2 — Assertive Outbound Phone Outreach & Vendor Chasing: Exceptional, highly professional spoken English (neutral accent) with strong confidence in making high-volume outbound phone calls to UK trade contractors to chase missing compliance documents and secure job allocations.



Skill 3 — B2B Marketplace & Systems Management: Hands-on experience with cloud CRM/ticketing platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Hubspot), cloud VoIP softphones (Aircall, RingCentral), and property management portals (Fixflo, Reapit, or similar ERPs).



Hands-On Execution & Strategic Adaptability: Ability to combine high-level strategic oversight and team building with hands-on execution during initial setup (taking customer calls, chasing documents, matching jobs) before scaling direct reports underneath you.



Advanced KPI, WFM & SLA Management: Deep proficiency in workforce management (WFM), quality assurance scoring, CSAT tracking, capacity planning, and data-driven team management.



Home Office / Flexible Workspace Requirements



Dedicated quiet home office setup free from background noise.

High-speed fiber internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/upload).

Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) / power backup capability for late-night mid-shift stability.



What We Offer



Competitive compensation package negotiable based on experience (base pay, non-taxable allowances, HMO healthcare coverage, and performance incentives).



Fixed Monday–Friday schedule (UK daytime hours: 9 AM – 6 PM UK time).



100% remote position with optional co-working pass support for power/internet backup.



Direct executive career path to build, recruit, and lead a dedicated offshore BPO operations and customer support department in the Philippines as the marketplace expands.

title: Event Coordination VA for Fast-Growing Events Company in Australia
description:
How to apply — mandatory requirements



Two things are required from every applicant. No exceptions.

- A 3-minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, walk through your relevant coordination or events experience. Please speak naturally and DO NOT read from a script.

- Submit an updated CV in a PDF format



Applications missing either the Loom video or the CV will NOT be considered.



Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events. Each event runs across multiple days with 20–25+ vendors, a full marketing campaign, and a long list of suppliers to book and confirm. They run on a repeating monthly cycle, which means there is always one event in delivery and another in build.



We need a remote Event Operations Coordinator to own the moving parts from the moment an event is confirmed through to post-event close-out.



This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d
 the event theme, the commercial model or which vendors get accepted. You will be the person who makes sure everything that was d
 actually happens, on time.



What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Tracking vendor marketing compliance — required posts, countdown banners, event shares — and chasing before every posting deadline

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

- Updating the event website in WordPress/Elementor each cycle — dates, venue, map, parking, FAQs, vendor lineup, competition, images — and testing every link on desktop and mobile

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Supplier and infrastructure bookings: power, cool rooms, equipment hire, barriers and lighting, cleaning and waste, security — booking, confirming, and following up delivery and collection

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

- Vendor commissions, reconciliation, and the final post-event report



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating events, projects or operations remotely. Events experience is a strong bonus, but disciplined project coordination in any industry is highly regarded

- You are relentless about following up. A large part of this role is chasing people who haven't replied — politely, repeatedly, without being asked to

- Strongly detail-oriented, with a habit of recording proof rather than just marking things done

- Hands-on with WordPress and Elementor, or able to demonstrate you can learn it quickly — you'll be editing event pages yourself, not raising tickets

- Confident with task management tools, spreadsheets,
 marketing platforms and social scheduling

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main point of contact for dozens of vendors and suppliers

- Good judgement about what you handle yourself versus what you escalate

- Able to hold a lot of concurrent deadlines across two overlapping event cycles without dropping any



What success looks like:

- You've run at least one full event cycle end to end, from confirmation to close-out

- The tracker is current every working day and nothing sits overdue without being flagged

- Vendor compliance documents are collected ahead of deadline rather than chased in the final week

- The end-of-day report is running consistently and management is relying on it

- A complete post-event report has been delivered covering attendance, vendor sales, marketing performance and key learnings

title: Lightroom Photo Editor
description:
Looking for a skilled Lightroom photo editor to work with us on a per-project basis. 



IMPORTANT: Please do not respond without fully reading the job posting & attaching the required items to apply. 



What We're Looking For:



 A strong understanding of color to enhance the photography while still maintaining a premium looking image



Skin Tones: The ability to maintain accurate, flattering, and consistent skin tones across different lighting conditions and complexions.



Exposure Correction: Experience recovering underexposed, overexposed, and poorly lit images while maintaining a natural appearance.



White Balance: The ability to correct mixed lighting, unwanted color casts, and inconsistent temperatures.



Consistency: The ability to create a cohesive look across an entire event gallery, even when images are captured in different environments.



Lighting & Contrast: A strong eye for highlights, shadows, contrast, and tonal balance without making images look overly processed.



Composition: Understanding of cropping, straightening, and framing to improve the final presentation.



Detail & Retouching: Ability to reduce distracting elements, manage noise, and apply subtle corrections when necessary.



Efficiency: Ability to edit large batches of event photos while maintaining a high standard of quality.



Requirements



Proficient in Adobe Lightroom Classic



Experience editing professional event photography



Strong portfolio



Excellent attention to detail



Reliable communication and turnaround times



Ability to follow creative direction and maintain a consistent editing style





We've selected a handful of event photos ranging from poor-quality images with challenging lighting to well-exposed images.



We want to see your ability to:



Recover and improve challenging photos.



Create natural-looking color grades.



Maintain accurate skin tones.



Demonstrate your own creative judgment.



Our goal is to find someone who can deliver high-quality, consistent work and become a reliable long-term editing partner as projects come in.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your portfolio



Examples of before-and-after Lightroom edits.



Your typical rate per photo or per 30 edited photos.



Your average turnaround time for a gallery of 100–300 images.



These photos edited to the best of your ability: 







Extreme plus: Advanced Masking Skills 

This includes subject Masking: Enhancing subjects independently from their surroundings to create natural separation and visual emphasis.



Background Masking: Controlling background exposure, contrast, color, and distractions without affecting the subject.



Skin Masking: Making subtle, targeted adjustments to skin tones, texture, and exposure while maintaining a natural appearance.



Radial & Linear Gradients: Using selective light adjustments to guide the viewer's eye and create depth.



Brush Masking: Precisely adjusting specific areas of an image that require additional attention.



Selective Color Correction: Correcting unwanted color casts on subjects, clothing, or backgrounds without changing the entire image.



Someone who understands that great photo editing goes beyond applying a preset or making global adjustments. The ability to identify what an individual image needs and use masking intentionally is a MASSIVE plus.

title: Part-time appointment setter (US English, strong American accent)
description:
About the role

A licensed insurance agency needs a reliable part-time caller to contact
 leads and book in-person appointments for the licensed agent. This is not a sales job. You do not quote plans, discuss benefits, or enroll anyone. You confirm interest and put a qualified appointment on the calendar.

Hours and speed



Part-time, about 1–2 hours per day, Monday–Saturday, between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM Utah time (Mountain Time).



 leads must be called within 5 minutes of submitting during those hours. That is the main requirement of the job. If you cannot stay available and respond that fast during your shift, this role is not a fit.



What you will do

    •    Watch for new
 leads during your shift

    •    Call each new lead within 5 minutes

    •    Follow a short, approved script

    •    Confirm the person is in Utah and interested in a no-cost insurance review

    •    Book an in-person appointment (home or office) on the agent’s calendar

    •    Log every call: reached, no answer, not interested, booked, wrong number

    •    Send a short daily summary of calls and appointments set



Requirements (strict)

    •    Excellent spoken English with a clear, natural American accent. This is non-negotiable. Leads are older adults in Utah and must understand you easily on the first call.

    •    Strong understanding of American culture, phone etiquette, and how US seniors prefer to be spoken to (polite, clear, not rushed, no hard sell)

    •    Well-versed in many call platforms and CRM platforms (examples: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, RingCentral, Aircall, OpenPhone, or similar). You should be able to work inside an existing system with little training.

    •    Able to stay online and respond within 5 minutes during your scheduled hours

    •    Prior experience calling US customers is strongly preferred

    •    Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and a good headset

    •    Comfortable using a calendar booking link and updating lead status in a CRM

    •    Able to follow instructions exactly and not improvise sales talk

You will not

    •    Sell insurance or discuss specific plan benefits, premiums, or “best plans”

    •    Pressure anyone or keep calling after they say no

    •    Work outside the approved script without permission

    •    Let leads sit longer than 5 minutes during your shift



How to apply

Record a 60-second voice note résumé. Treat it like a spoken résumé: your name, where you are, your calling experience, the call platforms and CRMs you know, and why you can handle US leads. Speak as you would on a real call to an American customer.

Upload the voice note to Google Drive, set the link so anyone with the link can listen, and send that link with your application.



Also include in writing:

    •    Your city and time zone

    •    Which hours between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM Utah time you can cover

    •    Confirmation that you can call new leads within 5 minutes during those hours

    •    Call platforms and CRMs you have used



Applications without a working Google Drive voice-note link will not be reviewed. Pay is discussed with qualified applicants after the voice sample.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.
