title: Client Service & Outbound Sales Coordinator – U.S. Insurance Agency (Part-Time, 30 Hours/Week)
description:
**Company:** Station 5 Insurance  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** 30 hours per week, Monday–Friday, during U.S. Central Time business hours  

**Compensation:** $6 USD per hour, depending on experience, communication skills, and qualifications  

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with potential for growth



 About Us



Station 5 Insurance is an established independent insurance agency serving customers in Alabama and Texas. We have been in business for over 22 years and take pride in providing personalized, relationship-focused service.



We are looking for a friendly, confident, highly organized professional to join our team.



This is a hybrid **customer service and outbound calling position**. We need someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, can handle customer concerns with warmth and patience, and is comfortable making proactive calls to prospective and existing customers.



We are not looking for someone who simply answers calls and takes messages. We want someone who takes ownership, follows through, and helps us build stronger customer relationships.



 Your Responsibilities



**Inbound Customer Service (Approximately 60%)**



- Answer incoming customer calls professionally and warmly.

- Listen carefully to customer concerns and determine how best to assist.

- Help customers with routine insurance service inquiries and coordinate requests with our service team.

- Handle billing questions, policy document requests, claims intake, and other general inquiries within established procedures.

- Follow up with customers to ensure their requests are being addressed.

- Maintain accurate notes and track outstanding callbacks.

- Help direct customers to our agency's text-based service system when appropriate.

- Escalate questions requiring a licensed insurance agent.



**Outbound Calling & Business Development (Approximately 40%)**



- Contact former customers to explore opportunities to earn their business back.

- Call prospective customers from lead lists.

- Follow up with customers approaching their insurance renewal dates.

- Conduct follow-up calls on outstanding quotes and sales opportunities.

- Identify potential cross-selling opportunities with existing customers.

- Gather basic prospect information and schedule qualified opportunities for our licensed agents.

- Maintain organized records of calls, conversations, and follow-up dates.



You will not be expected to provide licensed insurance advice, recommend coverage, or bind insurance policies.



Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



- **Warm and personable:** You sound friendly, approachable, and genuinely interested in helping people.

- **Excellent on the telephone:** You speak clear, fluent, conversational English and can comfortably communicate with American customers.

- **Confident but not pushy:** You enjoy outbound calling and know how to start conversations without sounding like a scripted telemarketer.

- **Empathetic and patient:** You can calmly assist customers who may be frustrated or concerned about their insurance.

- **Proactive:** You recognize what needs to be done and take initiative rather than waiting for constant instructions.

- **Highly organized:** You follow through on commitments and maintain accurate records.

- **Dependable:** You show up consistently, communicate well, and take responsibility for your work.

- **Comfortable with technology:** You can learn insurance software, customer management systems, phone applications, and Google Workspace.



 Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is especially valuable:



- U.S. insurance agencies

- Insurance customer service or appointment setting

- Outbound calling, lead generation, or sales follow-up

- U.S.-based customer support

- CRM software and Google Workspace



Insurance experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right person.



Equipment Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, professional workspace

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Computer capable of running cloud-based business applications

- Reliable backup plan for internet or power interruptions



What We Offer



- Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. business

- Consistent part-time schedule

- Training and clear procedures

- Supportive team environment

- Opportunity to expand responsibilities as the business grows

- A position where your customer service and communication skills truly matter



 How to Apply



**Please follow these instructions carefully. Applications missing the requested information may not be considered.**



**1.** Begin your application with the words **"Station 5 Customer Experience"**.



**2.** Tell us about your experience handling inbound customer calls and making outbound sales or follow-up calls.



**3.** Describe how you would handle this situation:



*A customer calls upset because their homeowners insurance premium has increased significantly. They are frustrated and want to speak to someone immediately, but the licensed agent is unavailable. What would you say and do?*



**4.** Provide a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for this position. Please speak naturally, as if you were talking to a customer—not reading a prepared script.



**5.** Include your expected hourly rate in USD and your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



We are looking for someone who can become a valued, long-term member of our team. If you enjoy helping people, are comfortable making phone calls, and take pride in delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Editor & AI Animation Creator (Pixar, Claymation, 3D, AI UGC) – E-Commerce Ads
description:
We currently run 2 fast-growing D2C brands in the US market. We produce a high volume of paid ads on Meta and TikTok, and to keep up with our growth we're looking for an AI Video Editor who lives and breathes AI video, someone who can turn a script into a scroll-stopping ad in ANY visual style.



This is not a basic editing job. You will build full AI-generated ads from scratch: characters, scenes, animation, voiceover, sound and final edit.



=== WHAT YOU'LL DO ===

- Turn ad scripts into finished AI video ads (15–60 sec) for Meta & TikTok

- Create consistent AI characters across multiple scenes and videos

- Generate images and videos with AI tools, then edit them into polished ads

- Add voiceover, lip sync, music, sound effects, captions and on-screen text

- Produce multiple variations (hooks, styles, formats) for ad testing

- Stay on top of new AI tools and trends and bring new ad formats to the team



=== AI STYLES YOU MUST BE ABLE TO CREATE ===

The more of these you've done, the better:

- Pixar / Disney-style 3D animation

- Claymation / stop-motion

- Skeleton / X-ray ads (3D skeleton characters, "What happens if you..." format)

- 3D medical / anatomy visualizations (body inside view, muscles, circulation)

- Knitted / crochet / felt / plush style

- AI UGC (realistic AI creators, talking heads, testimonials)

- AI influencers & consistent AI avatars

- Talking objects, mascots & animated products

- Anime / cartoon / 2D illustration style

- LEGO / toy / miniature / diorama style

- Paper cut-out & handmade craft styles

- Cinematic hyper-realistic scenes & product shots

- Before/after & transformation sequences

- Trend formats (e.g. "fruit people", AI micro-dramas, POV stories, ASMR)



=== TOOLS (you should know most of these) ===

- Video: Kling, Veo 3, Sora, Seedance, Runway, Hailuo, Higgsfield

- Images: Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux, GPT Image, Ideogram

- Voice & lip sync: ElevenLabs, Hedra, HeyGen, Higgsfield lip sync

- Editing: CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, After Effects (bonus)

- Prompting: strong prompting skills (image-to-video, character consistency, camera movement)



=== REQUIREMENTS ===

- Portfolio with AI-generated videos (REQUIRED, no portfolio = no consideration)

- At least 1 year experience with AI video tools

- Strong sense for storytelling, pacing and hooks in short-form ads

- Experience with direct-response ads / e-commerce is a big plus

- Fluent written English, reliable internet, own computer

- Fast, organized and able to deliver multiple ads per week

- Available for some overlap with European time (CET)



=== WHAT WE OFFER ===

- Long-term, full-time position

- Paid access to all AI tools

- Room to experiment and create new formats

- Small, fast-moving team where your work directly impacts results



=== HOW TO APPLY ===

To show you read this, start your application with: "AI DIRECTOR"

Please include:

1. Link to your portfolio (AI videos only)

2. Which AI styles from the list above you've already created



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small paid test task.

title: Google Ads & Local Services Ads Analyst for a US Law Firm
description:
**About the role**



I run a legal marketing consultancy in Texas. One of my clients is a law firm spending around $40,000 a month on Google Ads, managed by an outside marketing agency. My job is to hold that agency accountable and make sure the firm's ad spend turns into signed cases, not just phone calls.



I need someone to be my eyes and ears on the numbers. Every week you'll go through the agency's dashboard and reports, figure out what's working and what isn't, and tell me in plain English what I should push the agency to change. You won't talk to the agency or the client directly. You'll report to me, and I'll take your findings into the room.



**What you'll do**



- Review the agency's dashboard and reports every week for Google Ads (PPC) and Google Business Profile

- Pull the search terms report each week and go through it line by line: keywords, search terms, negative keywords, geography, ad schedule and budget pacing

- Spot wasted spend, like search terms that bring in calls but never qualified leads, and flag it with a specific fix

- Compare lead quality by source (paid search, LSA, reviews, referrals) using intake data from the firm's CRM

- Send me a short weekly memo by end of day Monday (US Central Time) covering what changed, what's wasting money and the specific requests I should send the agency

- At month end, roll the weekly numbers into a one-page scorecard of spend, cost per lead, qualified leads and signed cases

- Check LSA coverage, budget and review activity across four Texas counties

- Keep an eye on how the firm shows up in AI search tools (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews) and note what the agency is or isn't doing about it



**What you need**



- At least 3 years managing or auditing Google Ads accounts, ideally with lead-generation clients rather than ecommerce

- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Google Business Profile

- Comfort reading agency reports critically. You should be able to tell when a report looks good but the results aren't there.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel)

- Clear written English. Your findings need to be short, specific and easy for a non-technical person to act on.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Willingness to sign an NDA. You'll be handling confidential client data.



**Nice to have**



- Experience with law firm or other professional services marketing in the US

- Familiarity with Clio Grow, CallRail or other call tracking tools

- Google Ads certification

- Knowledge of AEO or how businesses get found in AI search results

-Work Central Time, US hours (I'm in Texas)



**How to apply**



Start your application with the words "Eyes and Ears" so I know you read this posting. Then tell me in a few sentences about a Google Ads account you audited and one thing you found that the agency or previous manager had missed. Include your hourly or monthly rate and your available hours.



Shortlisted applicants will get a short paid test: a sample weekly search terms report to review and tell me what you'd cut and why.

title: Property Manager Asistant (Remote | Australian Property Management Experience Required)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Job Type: Full-Time (38 hours/week) or Part-Time (minimum 20 hours/week)

Salary: Negotiable based on experience (Please state your expected monthly rate)



About Us



We are a boutique real estate agency based in Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. We are a small, tight-knit team that values efficiency, honesty, and getting things done properly. We are looking for a reliable and experienced Property Management Assistant to join us remotely and help keep our property management operations running smoothly.



The Role



This is a remote back-office support role. You will NOT be required to conduct physical inspections or sign leases on behalf of the company. Instead, you will be the behind-the-scenes engine that keeps our property managers organised and our landlords and tenants happy.



You will work closely with our small team, handling administrative tasks, coordinating maintenance, and ensuring our Console Cloud database is always accurate and up to date.



Key Responsibilities



Administration: Daily data entry, updating tenancy details, uploading documents, and ensuring all records are accurate and current.

Maintenance Coordination: Receive maintenance requests from tenants, log them into Console Cloud, liaise with tradespeople for quotes, and follow up to ensure jobs are completed and invoiced correctly.

Tenant & Landlord Communication: Respond to general
 enquiries from tenants and landlords professionally and promptly. Draft and send routine correspondence (e.g., rent arrears reminders, inspection notices).

Lease Administration: Assist with preparing lease renewal documentation and sending out routine inspection letters/reports.

General Admin: File management, updating rental lists, and supporting the Principal with ad-hoc administrative tasks as required.

Requirements (Please read carefully)



Essential:



1. Excellent Written English & Chinese : You must be able to write clear, professional, and grammatically correct
s to landlords and tenants without constant supervision. Most of our landlord are Chinese, Oral and written Chinese is a must.



2. Australian Property Management Knowledge: You must understand basic Australian tenancy processes, including bond handling, routine inspections, and arrears follow-up.



3. Experience: You must have demonstrable hands-on experience using Console Cloud/Property Me/ Property Tree. This is non-negotiable. You will be tested on this during the interview via screen sharing.



4. Reliable Setup: A fast, stable internet connection, a working computer/laptop, and a quiet home office environment.



5. Time Zone: You must be available to work during Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) business hours.



6. Previous experience working directly for an Australian real estate agency.

What We Offer



Long-term Stability: We are not looking for a short-term project. We want someone who wants to grow with our business.

Direct Communication: You will work directly with the business owner, not through layers of management.

Supportive Environment: We value your input and will treat you as a core part of our team.

Fair Pay: We pay fairly for the right person and review performance regularly.

How to Apply



Please do NOT send a generic resume. To be considered, your application must include:



A brief cover letter (in English).

Confirmation of you can speak fluent English and Chinese.

Confirmation of your Australian Property Management Experience.

Confirmation of your available working hours in AEST.

Your expected monthly salary (in AUD or PHP).



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a screen-sharing interview to demonstrate their skills.

description:
Job Description



We are seeking a dedicated Medical Biller specializing in Payment Posting to support our Billing Team.



As our billing workload continues to increase, an additional team member focused on payment posting will help ensure that payments, adjustments, and denials are processed accurately and in a timely manner. This role will also help identify payment discrepancies and outstanding balances sooner, maintain accurate patient and insurance accounts, and improve the overall efficiency of our revenue cycle operations.



Key Responsibilities

3. Process manual and automated payment postings and verify transactions before finalization.

7. Maintain accurate payment records and assist with accounts receivable reconciliation.

8. Coordinate with the Billing Team to resolve payment posting issues.

9. Follow payer guidelines and HIPAA requirements when handling protected health information (PHI).

10. Prepare payment reconciliation reports using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets as needed.



Qualifications



1. At least 1–2 years of medical billing experience, preferably in payment posting or accounts receivable.

2. Knowledge of EOBs, ERAs, EFT transactions, and insurance payment processing.

3. Experience with Medicare, Medicaid/Medi-Cal, HMO, PPO, and commercial insurance payments.

4. Basic understanding of CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, and payer guidelines.

5. Experience with medical billing or practice management systems, preferably Elation or a similar platform.

6. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial transactions.Familiarity with payment reconciliation and identifying discrepancies.

7. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is preferred.

8. Good organizational, communication, and time-management skills.

9. Knowledge of HIPAA and proper handling of confidential patient information.



Work Requirements

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
About Focusly

Focusly helps Shopify brands turn their
 list into a revenue channel. We build and run
 marketing for ecommerce stores, and we design and develop the websites those stores run on.



Our clients range from founders launching their first Shopify store to established brands who want their
 program run properly. Most of them come to us for one of two things:
 marketing that pays for itself, or a store that converts.



_______________



The Role

We are hiring a Lead Generation Specialist to own the top of our sales pipeline. Your job is to find Shopify store owners who need
 marketing, new website, or social media marketing, start conversations with them, and hand qualified leads to our team to close.



This is a hunting role, not a list-building role. You will be measured on qualified conversations booked, not on the size of your spreadsheet. You will work directly with the founder and have a real say in how our outbound engine is built.



_______________



Who you'll be finding?

Our best leads are Shopify merchants, or people about to become one. You will target four profiles:



1.Already doing
 marketing

-Running a Shopify/WooCommerce/Magento store with Klaviyo, Mailchimp or similar; sending campaigns but flows, segmentation or revenue per send are weak



2.New to
 marketing

-Running a Shopify store with a growing customer list but no flows, no regular campaigns, or just installed an
 platform



3.Wants to launch a Shopify store

-Selling on Etsy, Amazon, Instagram or a legacy platform; planning to move to Shopify or launch a new brand



4.Needs a better website

-Existing store with a dated theme, poor mobile experience or low conversion rate



A good lead is a decision-maker (founder, owner, marketing lead) at a store doing enough volume to justify an agency, who has a clear problem we solve. You will help us sharpen this profile as you learn what converts.



_______________



What you'll do?

• Build targeted lists of Shopify merchants who match our lead profiles, using tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Store Leads, BuiltWith and Shopify app directories (or any tool that you're proficient with)

• Qualify each lead before outreach: confirm they are on Shopify (or moving to it), check their
 setup, estimate store size, and find the decision-maker

• Run multi-channel outbound: cold
 sequences, LinkedIn outreach and, where it fits, Instagram or phone

• Write and test outreach copy and sequences, and keep improving reply and meeting rates

• Book discovery calls for the founder and sales team, and make sure every booked lead is briefed and shows up

• Keep the CRM clean and current: every lead, touchpoint, status and next step logged

• Report weekly on pipeline numbers: leads sourced, contacted, replied, qualified and booked

• Spot patterns in what converts and feed that back into our targeting, messaging and offers

• Keep deliverability healthy: domain warm-up, sending limits, bounce and spam-rate monitoring



_______________



Must have

• 3 to 5 years in lead generation, SDR or outbound sales, with a track record you can show in numbers (leads sourced, reply rates, meetings booked)

• Experience selling to ecommerce or DTC brands, or to agencies that serve them

• Working knowledge of Shopify: you can look at a store and tell whether it is on Shopify, what apps it runs, and roughly how big it is

• Enough understanding of
 marketing to spot a weak program and talk about flows, campaigns and list growth without a script

• Hands-on with at least one prospecting stack: Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Smartlead, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar

• Strong written English: your outreach copy is short, specific and gets replies

• Comfortable with a CRM such as HubSpot, Pipedrive or GoHighLevel, and disciplined about keeping it current

• Self-managing: you set weekly targets, hit them, and tell us early when something is not working



_______________



Nice to have

• You have worked at an
 marketing agency or a Shopify agency

• You have used Klaviyo, Mailchimp or Omnisend and know the ecommerce
 landscape

• You have sold website or Shopify development services

• You can run basic phone or video qualification calls

• You have built lists with Store Leads, BuiltWith, Clay or similar enrichment tools



_______________



How to apply?

Send the following to us:

1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile

2. Your numbers from your last lead generation role: leads sourced per month, average reply rate, meetings booked per month, and how you qualified a lead (Portfolio)

3. A short note on how you would find 50 Shopify stores that are new to
 marketing, and which tools you would use

4. One cold
 you would send to a Shopify store owner who has a customer list but no
 flows (under 120 words)

Use the subject line "Lead Generation Specialist - [Your name]". Applications without items 1 to 4 will not be reviewed.

We will reply to shortlisted candidates within 5 business days with a short screening call.

Knowledge of Saskatoon or the Okanagan

Work directly with the business owner, no layers of management

title: YouTube Shorts Video Editor - Commentary Shorts with Captions and Voiceover
description:
We're hiring a video editor to produce YouTube Shorts from clips of real public confrontations: the "Karen" genre of store, parking lot, neighbour and road rage arguments. For each Short you'll receive the clip, a 5-line narration script and the voiceover audio. You'll cut the clip into a vertical Short, place the voiceover, add animated captions, a title and our branded overlays, and upload it to our Google Drive. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



Fast, clean, phone-first editing: the story is easy to follow, captions are accurate and readable, and every Short looks like part of the same channel.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Trim each clip to 1.5–3 minutes so the story is clear: who started it, how it escalates and how it ends.



- Frame it for vertical 9:16, with the clip in the centre and a blurred copy filling the background.



- Place the 5 voiceover lines at their script timestamps and lower the clip's audio under them so both are clear.



- Add word-by-word animated captions for both the clip's dialogue and the voiceover, using our caption style, and check every word.



- Add the title banner, channel logo, camera-frame overlay and a credit to the original filmer, plus circles and arrows on key moments.



- Mute or bleep slurs and strong swearing following our guide.



- Export to our settings and upload the finished Shorts to our shared Google Drive folder each day.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Examples of vertical Shorts, TikToks or Reels you edited yourself, with animated captions, and an explanation of what you did on each.



- Strong English comprehension for checking captions against fast, heated speech.



- Confidence with your editing software (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar), including caption animation and audio ducking.



- Consistency. You can follow a template so every Short matches.



- Comfort working with heated arguments, some with swearing and offensive language.



- A reliable computer and internet connection for daily exports and uploads.



Workload: 2–3 Shorts per working day. Clips, scripts, voiceovers and templates are supplied.



Turnaround: Daily batches; delivery times will be agreed with the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "mango" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link



3. Links to 2–3 vertical videos you edited with animated captions, and what you did on each



4. Links to any YouTube channels you've edited for, what you did and when (or "none yet")



5. The editing software you use



6. Your expected rate (per Short or per month)



7. The hours you can work each day



8. Your 
 username (if you have it)



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–7 won't be reviewed.

title: Customer Success Operations Manager (Talent, Training & Workforce Operations) - $2,000 to $2,500 USD p/m + Bonuses
description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is currently full, but new spots can open at any time as our team grows. We're still accepting applications and interviewing qualified candidates for our waitlist. If you're a good fit, you'll be among the first people we reach out to when a spot opens!



Full-Time | Long-Term Leadership Role



Salary:

- Starting base: $2,000 per month, depending on approved experience level

- Full base: $2,500 per month plus performance-based bonuses, once certification requirements are met



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is not a short-term job.

We build long-term leadership inside the company.



You'll make sure our Client Success team has the right people, trained well and doing great work. You'll work directly with leadership to improve how we hire, train, and manage the team.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher: 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position

- Monday to Friday schedule: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours per week

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear salary progression

- High-growth environment where you'll be a core part of the company's growth

- Real ownership: you will directly shape how we deliver for clients

- Tight-knit leadership team that moves fast and values initiative

- Clear path to senior leadership or director level

- Full work-from-home flexibility

- Access to paid AI tools and systems

- Strong company culture



TASKS



Recruiting, Hiring & Headcount Planning

- Plan hiring needs by reviewing team capacity, client volume, turnover risk, and ramp time, so hiring starts before service levels drop.

- Run the hiring pipeline with Recruiting and keep strong candidates moving through CV, Loom, test task, interview, and roleplay stages.

- Assess candidates on judgment, ownership, process discipline, coachability, client communication, reliability, and schedule fit.

- Keep a ready bench of qualified backup candidates for upcoming hiring needs.

- Track candidate volume, quality, conversion, hires, and early new-hire failures to keep improving hiring standards.



New-Hire Onboarding, Training & Ramp

- Make sure new hires have Hubstaff, Slack, Airtable, modules, documents, calendars, tools, hardware, work schedule, and time-zone setup ready before training starts.

- Manage training curriculum, quizzes, exams, tasks, progress, deadlines, and roleplay or certification steps before new hires work independently.

- Spot slow or weak trainees early and turn repeated gaps into retraining, SOPs, templates, checklists, and training resources.



Workforce Operations & Talent Management

- Monitor schedules, Hubstaff, leave, absences, time-zone coverage, utilization, backup coverage, and headcount needs to catch staffing risks early.

- Coordinate retraining, warnings, performance improvement plans, and monthly talent reviews, with clear recommendations backed by evidence.

- Keep hiring, onboarding, and workforce data accurate, and turn repeated people problems into permanent fixes.



You own outcomes here. We expect you to take charge, solve problems, and keep systems running smoothly.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years in CS Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Training/L&D, Workforce Operations, or Team Management (high-ticket coaching, online education, SaaS, BPO, or another fast-moving remote business).

- Proven track record recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, training, or ramping customer-facing employees at volume.

- Strong skills in Airtable/CRMs, Google Sheets, hiring or training trackers, workforce reporting, and data validation.

- Experience building structured hiring and training systems using scorecards, test tasks, interviews, roleplays, certification standards, and clear pass/fail criteria.

- Proven ability to turn hiring, onboarding, reliability, or performance problems into clear SOPs, training, and accountability processes.



OPTIONAL BUT PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Hiring or training CSMs, account managers, coaches, support staff, or other client-facing roles in a high-ticket or service-based business

- Hubstaff, Airtable, remote workforce management, hiring automation, or AI-assisted recruiting and training

description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is currently full, but new spots can open at any time as our team grows. We're still accepting applications and interviewing qualified candidates for our waitlist. If you're a good fit, you'll be among the first people we reach out to when a spot opens!



This role is for a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.

Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050-$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30-$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20-25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30-45 minutes. Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY

title: Dental Biller/ Virtual Assistant w/ Experience
description:
We are looking for a Virtual Dental Insurance Biller to manage insurance claims, maximize collections, reduce outstanding accounts receivable, and ensure timely reimbursement



Key Responsibilities

-Submit accurate dental insurance claims electronically and manually when necessary.

-Review claims for correct CDT codes, documentation, narratives, and supporting radiographs.

-Follow up on unpaid, rejected, denied, and underpaid claims.

-Manage insurance accounts receivable (A/R), including aging reports for 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and 90+ days.

-Post insurance payments, EOBs, and ERAs accurately.

-Identify and resolve insurance payment discrepancies.

-Submit corrected claims, appeals, and reconsiderations.

-Understand PPO fee schedules, contractual adjustments, and coordination of benefits (COB).

-Communicate with insurance companies to resolve outstanding claims.

-Provide weekly billing reports detailing collections, outstanding claims, denials, and A/R performance.

-Maintain accurate patient financial records and comply with HIPAA requirements.



Candidates must have:

-Minimum 2–3 years of U.S. dental insurance billing experience.

-Strong understanding of CDT codes and dental terminology.

-Experience billing major PPO insurance carriers, including Delta Dental, Aetna, Cigna, MetLife, Guardian, and UnitedHealthcare.

-Knowledge of insurance billing for crowns, bridges, veneers, implants, periodontal procedures, oral surgery, endodontics, and removable prosthetics.

-Experience writing or preparing insurance narratives and submitting supporting clinical documentation.

-Strong knowledge of claim denials, appeals, timely filing limits, and insurance reimbursement procedures.

-Experience managing dental insurance A/R and collecting outstanding balances.

-Familiarity with dental practice management software

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

-Reliable internet connection and a secure, private workspace.

, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time





How to apply:



- Start your message with the words “Organic Growth”, so we know you read this ad.

- Record a Loom video (max 10 minutes) auditing 
. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

- Share one case study with real numbers: what the situation was, what you did, and what happened to traffic and leads and how long it took.

- In 2–3 sentences, explain how you’d earn high-quality links for a finance company without buying them.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.





If you’re a good fit, we’ll setup a Zoom interview to see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: B2B Cold Caller / SDR (US & Canada, Full-Time)
description:
**What we’re looking for**



Strong spoken business English is essential for this role. You should speak clearly and naturally, be easy to understand over the phone, and feel confident speaking with managers and directors in the U.S. and Canada. A U.S. accent is a plus.



**About Knowaa**



Knowaa is a creative learning studio focused on digital training. We help companies turn employee training into experiences people want to engage with and that are designed to deliver measurable results.



We create custom videos, animation, interactive courses, gamified learning experiences, and AI-based learning solutions.



**The role**



We’re looking for an experienced outbound Sales Development Representative to help us connect with Learning & Development (L&D) and training leaders in the U.S. and Canada.



You’ll speak with the people responsible for employee learning and training, introduce our services, ask a few good questions, and book introductory meetings with our team. We’re looking for someone who uses a script as a starting point, listens carefully, and keeps the conversation natural.



The role includes a guaranteed base salary and performance bonuses.



**What you’ll do**



- Call L&D, training, and enablement managers and directors at companies with 400 or more employees.

- Target 100+ calls per day using our power dialer once you’re fully onboarded.

- Introduce our services, handle objections, and identify whether a conversation with our team makes sense.

- Book and confirm qualified meetings, and follow up on cancellations or no-shows.

- Follow up with prospects by
 and LinkedIn when appropriate.

- Log call outcomes, useful notes, and next steps in HubSpot.

- Join a 20-minute daily coaching call with our VP of Business Development and share what you’re hearing from prospects.



Our team handles detailed discovery, proposals, pricing, and closing. Your focus is starting the right conversations and booking qualified meetings.



**Schedule**



Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.



**Pay**



Paid in U.S. dollars twice per month.



- Base salary: **$900–$1,300/month**, depending on experience.

- Meeting bonus: **$25–$40 for each qualified meeting you book that takes place**. Your rate will be agreed before you start.



There is no cap on qualifying meeting bonuses. A qualified meeting is one where a relevant L&D, training, or enablement stakeholder attends, the company fits our agreed target criteria, and there is a clear reason to explore working with us. We’ll review the full qualification criteria with you before you begin.



**What we’re looking for**



- At least two years of outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience for U.S. or Canadian B2B companies.

- Strong spoken English with clear pronunciation and a confident, natural phone manner.

- Experience speaking with managers and directors at mid-size or large companies.

- Experience reaching decision-makers, handling objections, and following up consistently.

- Power dialer experience and accurate CRM recordkeeping. HubSpot is a plus.

- Ability to listen carefully, have a real conversation, and apply feedback.

- A quiet workspace, noise-canceling headset, internet speed of at least 50 Mbps, and a backup power or internet plan.



**Nice to have**



- Experience selling training, HR, consulting, or other professional services.

- Familiarity with eLearning or corporate training.

- Experience reaching L&D or training decision-makers.



**What we provide**



- Power dialer and prospect lists.

- Scripts, a sales playbook, and examples of our work.

- Training on our services and target audience.

- Call recordings to learn from.

- Daily coaching and direct communication with our VP of Business Development.



**How to apply**



1. Start your application with **“LEARNING.”**

2. Attach a **1–2 minute voice recording**. Introduce yourself, then demonstrate the first 30 seconds of a cold call to a Director of Learning & Development.

3. Tell us about your best month in an outbound role: approximately how many dials, conversations, and meetings did you generate? Please let us know whether the leads were cold or warm.

4. List the dialers and CRMs you’ve used.

5. Share your expected monthly base pay and when you could start.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



**Hiring process**



We’ll review applications and voice recordings, then invite shortlisted candidates to a 30-minute call.

title: Remote Marketing Agency Recruiter - Flexible Schedule
description:
We are a growing US-based digital marketing agency focused on helping brands build and expand their presence through organic TikTok marketing campaigns. Our team provides the content, while our network of creators publishes slideshow videos on newly created TikTok accounts to promote different brands and products.



We are currently expanding our creator network in the Philippines and looking for motivated, dependable, and proactive individuals to help us find potential creators, conduct outreach, and guide new recruits through the application and onboarding process.



We have a limited number of positions available and are looking for people who are serious about the opportunity. Consistent effort, accountability, and reliable communication are essential to success in this role.



 Responsibilities: 



- Find Filipino creators interested in earning money by posting TikTok slideshow content.

- Identify potential creators through
 groups, Reddit communities, 
 servers, TikTok, university networks, and freelancer platforms.

- Reach out to potential creators using our provided templates while keeping messages natural and personalized.

- Answer questions from interested creators and help them complete the application and onboarding process.

- Track daily outreach activity, including the number of people contacted and application forms sent.

- Submit daily check-ins detailing recruitment progress, outreach results, and any challenges encountered.

- Stay responsive to team messages and keep the team updated on your progress.

- Communicate proactively if you need assistance, encounter difficulties, or anticipate challenges meeting recruitment goals.



 What We're Looking For:



- Strong written English and professional communication skills.

- Confidence in initiating conversations and contacting people online.

- A self-motivated, organized, consistent, and coachable attitude.

- Willingness to follow instructions and work toward recruitment targets.

- Comfort with repetitive outreach and performance-based compensation.

- Ability to check in daily, provide progress reports, and respond to messages in a timely manner.

- Reliability and a willingness to take responsibility for assigned tasks.

- A valid PayPal account to receive payments.



Previous experience in recruitment, lead generation, sales, social media management, community management, or customer support is helpful, but a willingness to learn and follow the process is also important.



Daily Communication Is Mandatory:



This position offers a flexible schedule, but consistent communication is a requirement.



You must check in with the team every day, report your outreach activity, and remain responsive to team messages. We understand that you may have school, another job, or other commitments, so you can choose when to work as long as you maintain daily activity and keep the team informed.



Applicants who regularly go silent, fail to submit updates, or repeatedly ignore team messages may lose their position. Communication and accountability are just as important as recruitment results.



Schedule and Compensation:



Schedule: Completely flexible. You choose your working hours, provided you complete your daily outreach, submit your check-ins, and maintain consistent communication with the team.



This is not an hourly position, and there are no fixed working hours. However, daily activity, progress reporting, and communication are expected.



Base pay: $20 per 30-day cycle, plus performance-based earnings for every creator you recruit who successfully completes onboarding.



Minimum Recruitment Requirements:



You must recruit at least 35 creators who successfully complete onboarding during a 30-day cycle to qualify for the $20 base payment.



The average recruiter brings in approximately 50 completed hires per cycle. This is the performance target we encourage you to aim for, while 35 completed hires remains the minimum requirement for base-pay eligibility.



- Fewer than 35 completed hires: You will not qualify for the $20 base payment. You will receive $1 per successfully onboarded creator.

- 35–50 completed hires: You qualify for the $20 base payment, plus $1 per completed hire.

- 51–100 completed hires: You qualify for the $20 base payment, with performance pay based on the earnings ladder below.

- 101 or more completed hires: You qualify for the $20 base payment, with performance pay based on the earnings ladder below.



30-Day Performance Earnings Ladder:



- 1–50 completed hires: $1 per hire

- 51–100 completed hires: $2 per hire

- 101+ completed hires: $3 per hire



Each earnings cycle lasts 30 days, and your progress resets when a new cycle begins. Payments are made through PayPal at the end of each cycle.



Base-pay eligibility and continued participation depend on meeting recruitment expectations, maintaining daily communication, and submitting the required progress reports.



Limited Positions and Growth Opportunities:



We have a limited number of openings and want to bring on individuals who are genuinely committed to contributing to our agency's growth.



Strong performers who consistently deliver recruitment results, communicate reliably, and demonstrate professionalism may have opportunities to advance into Recruitment Manager or Client Manager positions within our agency.



If you are dependable, willing to learn, and ready to put in consistent daily effort, we encourage you to apply.



How to Apply:



Please answer the following two questions in your application.



1. Where would you find potential creators?



Name three specific online places where you would look for Filipino TikTok creators interested in earning money by posting content. Provide actual examples of groups, communities, or platforms rather than simply naming broad platforms such as
 or 
.



2. Why would you be a good fit for this role?



Explain why you believe you would succeed in this position. Highlight any relevant experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, lead generation, sales, social media, community management, or customer support. Also explain how you would organize your leads, conduct daily outreach, track your results, and maintain consistent communication with the team.



We are looking for serious applicants who are ready to take responsibility, remain active, communicate daily, and grow with our agency.



Important Note: This Is a Flexible Side-Income Opportunity



This position is designed for individuals who want to earn additional income alongside their studies, current job, or other commitments. It is not a traditional full-time or hourly part-time role. Earnings are intended to supplement—not replace—your primary income.



You can choose your own working hours, but flexibility does not mean inactivity. Daily outreach, daily check-ins, timely responses, and consistent communication with the team are required.



If you are motivated, dependable, and ready to contribute to a growing digital marketing agency, we encourage you to submit your application.

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist
description:
Job Overview:  



We are looking for a highly experienced, data-driven Senior Google Ads Specialist with a minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience managing, optimizing, and scaling Google Ads campaigns.



The ideal candidate must have an in-depth understanding of Google Ads at an agency level, with a proven track record of generating high-quality leads, reducing Cost Per Lead (CPL), optimizing Cost Per Click (CPC), improving conversion rates, and maximizing advertising performance.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to launch campaigns. We need a performance marketing expert who understands the complete advertising funnel, can interpret performance data, identify inefficiencies, develop winning strategies, and consistently deliver measurable results across multiple campaigns and client accounts.



The candidate must be confident in managing substantial advertising budgets, handling multiple accounts simultaneously, and making strategic decisions based on data rather than assumptions.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Google Ads Campaign Management

Plan, execute, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Local Services Ads (LSA), and remarketing campaigns.



Conduct advanced keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and negative keyword management.

Develop effective campaign structures, ad groups, bidding strategies, audience segments, and conversion-focused ad copy.



Optimize CPC, CPL, conversion rates, impression share, Quality Score, and overall campaign profitability.



Identify wasted ad spend, irrelevant search queries, poor-performing keywords, and underperforming campaigns.



Manage bidding strategies, including Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Maximize Conversion Value, and Target ROAS, where appropriate.



Analyze search terms, device performance, geographic performance, audience behavior, and landing page effectiveness.

Develop and execute remarketing strategies to improve lead generation and conversion performance.



Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, ad disapprovals, tracking discrepancies, and account performance fluctuations.



Conduct regular campaign audits and implement structured optimization strategies to improve performance.



2. CPL, CPC & Performance Optimization: 



The candidate must have a deep, practical understanding of CPL and CPC, including how these metrics affect campaign efficiency, lead generation, and business profitability.



Monitor and optimize Cost Per Click (CPC), Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Click-Through Rate (CTR), conversion rate, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).



Understand the relationship between CPC, landing page conversion rate, lead quality, and final acquisition cost.



Diagnose why CPL or CPC is increasing and develop actionable strategies to bring costs under control.



Optimize campaigns based on business objectives rather than clicks or impressions alone.



Calculate target CPL and allowable acquisition costs based on client budgets, sales conversion rates, and business economics.



Identify opportunities to increase lead volume without compromising lead quality or exceeding target CPL.



Analyze performance at campaign, ad group, keyword, search term, audience, and device levels.



Allocate budgets based on performance data, conversion quality, and campaign growth opportunities.



Understand the difference between generating inexpensive leads and generating leads that convert into actual sales.



Provide clear recommendations backed by data, testing results, and measurable performance improvements.



3. Conversion Tracking & Analytics: 



*Set up, audit, and troubleshoot Google Ads conversion tracking.

*Work with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and relevant call tracking and lead tracking systems.

*Understand attribution models, conversion windows, tracking discrepancies, and reporting limitations.

*Track form submissions, phone calls, qualified leads, and other meaningful business conversions.

*Ensure campaigns are optimized against reliable conversion signals and appropriate business outcomes.

*Analyze landing page performance, funnel drop-offs, and conversion behavior.

*Identify discrepancies between Google Ads reporting, analytics platforms, and actual leads recorded by the business.

*Ensure tracking is configured correctly before making major campaign optimization decisions.



4. Agency-Level Account Management:



*Manage multiple Google Ads accounts, campaigns, budgets, and performance targets simultaneously.

*Develop campaign strategies based on individual client goals, target audiences, industries, and competitive environments.

*Conduct regular account audits and identify strategic opportunities for growth and efficiency.

*Communicate campaign performance, challenges, results, and next steps to internal teams and stakeholders.

*Forecast lead volumes, expected CPL, budget requirements, and scaling opportunities using realistic assumptions.

*Maintain campaign documentation, testing plans, optimization logs, and performance benchmarks.

*Collaborate with account managers, sales teams, developers, and landing page specialists to improve campaign results.

*Required Qualifications & Experience

*Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

*Proven experience working in a digital marketing agency or managing multiple client accounts in a performance-driven environment.

*Demonstrable results in lead generation, CPL reduction, CPC optimization, conversion rate improvement, and campaign scaling.

*In-depth knowledge of Google Ads campaign structures, bidding strategies, keyword targeting, remarketing, and budget management.

*Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex campaign data and translate insights into action.

*Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and call tracking systems.

*Strong understanding of landing pages, attribution, audience behavior, and conversion optimization.

*Ability to manage advertising budgets responsibly and make data-backed budget allocation decisions.

*Experience explaining campaign results in terms of business impact.

*Excellent problem-solving, communication, prioritization, and strategic planning skills.

*Mandatory Performance Expectations

*The successful candidate must demonstrate:

*Real campaign experience: Hands-on experience managing campaigns, advertising budgets, and performance targets, not *just theoretical platform knowledge.

*CPL expertise: The ability to calculate, diagnose, forecast, and optimize cost per lead while maintaining lead quality.

*CPC expertise: A clear understanding of Google Ads auctions, keyword intent, competition, Quality Score, and the factors influencing click costs.

*Optimization expertise: The ability to identify performance bottlenecks and implement a structured optimization plan.

*Scaling expertise: Experience increasing lead volume and advertising budgets efficiently while monitoring marginal CPL and lead quality.

*Tracking expertise: The ability to verify conversion data and identify tracking issues before making optimization decisions.

*Agency-level execution: The ability to manage multiple client accounts, meet deadlines, and communicate effectively with internal teams.



*Evidence of results: The ability to present case studies, account performance data, or verifiable examples of campaign outcomes, subject to client confidentiality.



Preferred Additional Skills

*Experience in high-competition industries and lead-generation businesses.

*Strong knowledge of Local Services Ads, where relevant to the business.

*Knowledge of landing page conversion rate optimization (CRO).



Compensation & Employment Details

Long-term opportunity with an established U.S.-based digital marketing agency



Compensation based on demonstrated expertise, agency experience, and proven campaign performance



Performance-based compensation reviews and opportunities for advancement



Exceptional candidates with documented success managing substantial U.S. advertising budgets may be considered above the stated range



Important: We are seeking a senior-level Google Ads expert capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and consistently improving lead generation performance. Applicants must provide specific examples of actual campaign results, including advertising budgets, CPL improvements, conversion tracking experience, and measurable business outcomes.

title: CAD Senior Accountant
description:
About the firm



We're a Canadian CPA-led accounting firm helping small-business owners understand their finances, improve their systems and keep more of what they earn.



Our team works together across Edmonton, Manila and Puerto Princesa. We value clear communication, practical solutions and reliable work. 



The role



We're hiring a Senior Accountant to prepare Canadian small-business files from client records through to CPA review. You'll prepare compilation engagements, year-end working papers and tax returns, while helping junior and intermediate accountants develop their skills.



You'll report to our production manager, who coordinates workflow and priorities. This is primarily an internal role, suited to an experienced Canadian public practice accountant who enjoys preparing files, solving problems and supporting colleagues.



What you'll do



Prepare compilation engagement files under CSRS 4200, including year-end working papers and financial statements in CaseWare.

Prepare T2 corporate returns, T1 personal returns, supporting schedules and T-slips for CPA review.

Review QuickBooks Online records for accurate coding, GST/HST treatment and transaction completeness.

Prepare account reconciliations, GST/HST working papers and year-end adjusting entries with clear supporting documentation.

Investigate discrepancies and missing information and flag matters requiring further accounting or tax judgment to our Canadian CPA.

Assist junior and intermediate accountants with technical questions, reconciliations and file preparation, explain corrections and help them apply reviewer feedback.

Respond thoroughly to review notes and apply feedback to future files.

Keep tasks and file status current in Karbon, coordinate priorities with the production manager and flag potential delays early.



What you'll bring



At least five years of accounting experience, including Canadian compilation engagements and corporate and personal tax preparation.

Hands-on CaseWare Working Papers experience and the ability to prepare files through to reviewer submission.

Experience with Canadian tax software. TaxCycle is preferred; ProFile, Taxprep or similar experience is welcome.

Practical knowledge of Canadian corporate and personal tax, GST/HST and T-slips.

Strong QuickBooks Online and Excel skills.

Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain accounting issues and give constructive feedback.

Strong organization and the ability to balance your own deadlines with supporting colleagues.

A quiet home workspace and reliable internet.

Helpful, but not required: Philippine CPA designation or progress toward it; experience training junior accountants; Karbon or Dext experience; QBO ProAdvisor certification; Alberta corporate tax experience.



If you meet most of these requirements and have strong Canadian file-preparation experience, we encourage you to apply.



Schedule and work-life balance



Fully remote, with at least half your working day overlapping Alberta business hours, including availability for team meetings between 1:30 and 3:00 p.m. Alberta time (3:30–5:00 a.m. Philippine time the following day).

Your remaining hours are flexible around agreed deadlines and team coordination. This role requires regular overnight availability in the Philippines.

Corporate year-ends are spread throughout the year, helping distribute the workload. Some periods are busier, but overtime is not a regular expectation.



Compensation and benefits



₱100,000–₱130,000 per month, depending on relevant experience, plus 13th month pay.

Paid public holidays following the firm's Canadian holiday schedule, exchangeable day-for-day for Philippine holidays by prior arrangement.

Company-provided laptop, equipment and peripherals.

Paid professional development.

An annual reimbursed birthday treat.

Mid-year and Christmas virtual team gatherings.

Opportunities to develop your technical and coaching skills.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Content Manager
description:
Growing Digital Marketing Company | Remote | Full-Time



About Us

We are a growing digital marketing company looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and highly organized Content Manager to join our team. We help businesses grow their online presence through strategic digital marketing and high-quality content.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, loves staying organized, follows processes, and ensures that every piece of content is completed accurately and on time.



If you are someone who enjoys planning, managing multiple projects, coordinating tasks, and keeping everything running smoothly behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you!

Content Coordination: Coordinate content creation tasks with writers, designers, video editors, and other team members.

Project Management: Track deadlines, follow up on pending tasks, and ensure all content projects move forward on schedule.

Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented.

Has strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Can manage multiple projects and deadlines without losing track of details.

Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

Is reliable, accountable, and consistent with follow-through.

— Designing high-fidelity UI for web apps, dashboards, mobile screens and landing pages

— Building clickable prototypes and handing off clean, organized Figma files

— Creating and maintaining design systems (components, type, color, spacing)

— Working directly with developers to make sure what ships matches the design

— Using AI tools to explore ideas, generate variations and move faster



Must-haves:

— 3+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio of real, shipped work

— Expert in Figma or similar: components, auto layout, variants, prototyping

— A detailed, creative eye: typography, spacing, hierarchy, color and polish

— Strong UX thinking: you understand workflows and design for how people actually work

— Able to take a rough idea to high-fidelity concepts quickly

— Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Figma AI or similar)

— Clear written English, plus reliability and responsiveness



Big pluses:

— Experience designing SaaS, dashboards or internal tools

— Basic HTML/CSS or experience working closely with React/Next.js developers

— Motion or micro-interaction design

— E-commerce or Shopify design experience



Rate: $6-$10/hr, depending on skill



How to apply (applications that skip any step will not be reviewed):

— Use the subject line: “Pixel Perfect – [Your Name]”



Share your work:

— your portfolio link

— 1–2 case studies that show your process (problem, workflow, wireframes, final design)

— one live product or Figma file link you designed

— For one case study, tell us in 2–3 sentences exactly what you did. What was the brief, what did you design, and what did others contribute?



Confirm you can work at least 10 PM – 6 AM PH time, how many hours a week you’re available, and your hourly rate.
