title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
About the Role

We are an emerging beverage brand inspired by Ayurveda — the 5,000-year-old Indian wellness practice centered around daily rituals for a more holistic and balanced life. Currently growing our retail presence in New York City alongside our e-commerce business, we are entering an exciting stage of growth with additional product launches planned and a strong focus on building community and brand awareness across the U.S.

We're looking for a Social Media & Content Manager who can help co-lead our social media strategy while also being highly hands-on with day-to-day execution. This is not simply a scheduling or community management position — we want someone who brings ideas to the table, helps establish a clear content strategy, identifies what is and isn't working, and works closely with the founders to bring that strategy to life.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Strategy

Develop and help lead the organic social media strategy across Instagram and TikTok

Establish clear content pillars, formats, themes, and posting strategies rather than creating content on an ad-hoc basis

Help grow our presence and reach specifically within the U.S. market, with an initial focus on New York and relevant U.S. consumer communities

Identify opportunities to improve audience targeting and ensure content reaches the brand's intended demographic

Develop platform-specific strategies for Instagram and TikTok while identifying opportunities to repurpose high-performing content across channels

Build content plans around new product launches, retail growth, founder stories, and other key brand moments

2. Content Creation & Video Editing

Work closely with the founders to develop content ideas, scripts, hooks, and creative briefs for founder-led videos

Give the founders clear direction on what content should be filmed and how it should be structured

Edit founder-shot footage into engaging TikToks, Instagram Reels, and Stories

Create strong opening hooks, pacing, captions, and edits designed to maximize retention and engagement

Identify relevant TikTok, Instagram, and broader cultural trends and adapt them creatively for the brand

Help maintain a consistent brand voice, look, and feel across all social content

Develop organic content and creative concepts that can also be tested and repurposed as paid social advertising creatives

3. Publishing & Community Management

Own or support the day-to-day publishing of content across Instagram and TikTok

Manage comments, DMs, and general community engagement

Proactively engage with relevant U.S.-based consumers, creators, communities, and complementary brands

Help build genuine relationships around the brand rather than relying solely on paid audience acquisition

Identify relevant local communities, events, wellness groups, creators, and other opportunities that could strengthen our presence in New York and the wider U.S. market

4. Creator & UGC Support

Identify creators and UGC opportunities that align with our target customer and brand positioning

Coordinate basic creator outreach, product seeding, and UGC collaborations

Maintain creator lists and help manage communication and follow-ups

Identify high-performing creator content that could be repurposed across organic and paid channels

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years in social media management, social strategy, content marketing, or a similar role

Platforms: Strong experience managing and growing brands across Instagram and TikTok

Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop social media strategy as well as execute it

Video: Strong short-form video editing skills, particularly for TikTok and Instagram Reels; excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention, and short-form content best practices

Trends: Ability to identify trends and translate them into content that feels relevant to a specific brand rather than simply copying trends

Communication: Strong written English; ability to write engaging social copy, captions, scripts, and content concepts

Analytics: Comfortable analyzing social media performance and making recommendations based on data

Profile: Highly proactive, creative, and comfortable suggesting ideas rather than waiting for detailed instructions; sits somewhere between a Social Media Strategist, Content Manager, and hands-on Creator



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support), as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

• Preferred: Cyber Security education/experience

• Preferred: Hyper-V experience



Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more



HOW TO APPLY?



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "L2 Tech Support - August 2026".



In your
 body, you MUST include the following, and ONLY the following, please:

- An attachment of your resume in PDF format (Please update your resume before submitting it, as we use an AI-powered agent to review qualifications.)

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you have a 100% clean background with no criminal history.

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you understand the business hours (MST\ Arizona time zone.



Answer the following questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have working in an MSP company? Name of the MSP company/s you worked with.

2. Do you have at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role?

3. Do you have experience working with RMM and PSA software? What applications did you use?

4. Do you have experience working with Virtualization, servers, GPO, TCP/IP, hyper-v/vmware, conditional access, Intune, and Scripting such as PowerShell?

5. Have you recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more? What time zone and when?

6. Are you okay with the computer requirements and the rental arrangement described in the job details?

7. Do you have an internet speed of at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ upload speed?



- No other information/cover letter or attachments should be included, besides a simple salutation and signature if so desired.



NOTE: Please do NOT apply using other methods besides the above. Any applicants who reach out to us via phone, social media, or any method other than the instructions above will automatically be disqualified.

Only those who followed the above instructions will be contacted within 2 business days, with further instructions.





We're looking forward to having you join our family!

Previous Canadian real estate administrative experience is required. We’re looking for someone who already understands Canadian real estate processes, documentation and day-to-day administrative responsibilities.



You’ll be working closely with the Broker of Record and another experienced Executive Virtual Assistant, providing support across real estate, property management and executive administration.



We’re a small, supportive team looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well, thinks independently and enjoys finding solutions.



If you’re someone who takes initiative, stays one step ahead and loves keeping things organized, we’d love to hear from you!



What You’ll Be Helping With



* Real estate administration, listings, offers, leases and transaction coordination

* Property management, tenant communications, maintenance coordination and follow-ups

* Preparing and reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness

* Professional
 correspondence and client communication

* Calendar management, scheduling and executive assistance

* Organizing spreadsheets, records and confidential documents

* Managing tasks and deadlines using Asana

* Online research and occasional personal administrative projects

* Using AI tools to improve productivity and efficiency



What We’re Looking For



* Canadian real estate administrative experience is a must

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

* Ability to work independently, follow instructions and retain information

* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude

* Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel and Google Workspace

* Experience with Asana or similar project management software

* Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI tools is an asset

* Dependable, trustworthy and eager to grow with our team

title: Meta Ads Analyst (E-commerce) – Facebook Ads Performance & Creative
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe, spending on Meta ads every day. We're looking for someone with real Meta ads experience to review our ads, understand what's working and why, and help our manager d
 what to do next.



What you'll do:



Analysing our ads (around 75% of the role)

- Review our Meta campaigns across all our brands and track the numbers each week to spot trends

- Work out which ads and angles are working, which are dropping, and why

- Spot ad fatigue early, looking at frequency, CTR, CPA and ROAS across TOF, MOF and BOF ads

- When a brand drops, find the reason: the creatives, the hooks, the price, the offer, the product page or the competition

- Work with our manager to d
 which brands need new ads, what kind of ads to make next and which products to test



Product research (around 25% of the role)

- Use our custom internal tools to find new products for us to test (does all the research work for you)

- Keep a ranked list of the best products for us to launch next

- Find the best reference videos and image ads for our editors



The product research side is easy to learn, and we'll show you exactly how we do it. The ads side is where we need your experience.



Reporting

- A short daily report and a more detailed weekly report in Google Sheets



You should have:

- Proven experience with Meta Ads Manager, either running ads yourself or analysing them for a brand or agency

- A strong understanding of frequency, CTR, CPM, CPA and ROAS, and how they connect

- Experience with creative analysis: why an ad works, what makes a good hook and angle, and when an ad is fatiguing

- Understanding of TOF, MOF and BOF and how they behave differently

- E-commerce or dropshipping experience is a big plus

- Good with Google Sheets

- Clear written English, your reports need to be easy to read and act on

- Reliability: you show up every day and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $5/hour, 3 hours a day, 7 days a week (21 hours a week). This is a starting rate and we're very happy to increase it when the work is good

- Bonuses when your recommendations perform well

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale

- A team that listens. We want your ideas on how the work could be done better



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "AD ANALYST" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your experience with Meta ads: what accounts you've worked on, roughly how much spend, and what your role was

3. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Mortgage Telemarketing & Lead Generation Manager
description:
Equitable Lending is seeking one experienced Telemarketing & Lead Generation Manager with at least five years of mortgage industry experience to lead a team of 5–10 lead generation telemarketers.



This is a hands-on management role with direct responsibility for daily production, caller accountability, training, and transfer quality. Your mission is to develop a disciplined team that consistently connects our loan officers with high-intent prospects who have a genuine mortgage need and are ready to discuss their financing options.



Core Responsibilities:



Own daily production: Manage team schedules, lead assignments, dialing activity, follow-up, and live transfers. Establish clear individual and team goals and actively coach callers toward those goals throughout the day.



Define a qualified transfer: Ensure callers confirm the prospect’s financing objective, interest, timing, and willingness to speak with a loan officer. Transfers must include accurate notes and a clear explanation of the client’s needs.



Manage the transfer process: Coordinate with loan officers so interested prospects receive a timely, professional handoff. Address missed transfers, unavailable loan officers, and incomplete handoffs promptly.



Build consistent processes: Document scripts, qualification questions, lead dispositions, follow-up cadences, transfer procedures, and escalation paths.



Improve results: Identify which lead sources, scripts, calling periods, and coaching methods generate meaningful conversations and accepted transfers. Use those findings to improve production.



Report performance: Provide daily production updates and a weekly report covering activity, qualified transfers, loan officer feedback, downstream conversion, and corrective actions.



Accountability — Every Transfer Must Have Value:



Monitor dialer and CRM dashboards daily for dials per hour, connection rates, talk time, schedule adherence, follow-up completion, and qualified transfers per caller.



Verify activity against call recordings and CRM records. Address unexplained idle time, ghost dialing, inaccurate dispositions, duplicate leads, and inflated transfer counts.



Measure both transfer volume and transfer quality, including loan officer acceptance, prospect engagement, and progression to an application.



Prevent rushed, misleading, or unwanted transfers. A prospect must understand why they are being connected and agree to speak with a loan officer.



Review rejected transfers with loan officers, identify recurring issues, and coach callers on specific improvements.



Set clear expectations, document performance gaps, and follow through on improvement plans.



Quality and Training — Develop Callers Who Earn the Handoff:



Own onboarding and ongoing training in mortgage fundamentals, discovery questions, objection handling, follow-up, CRM documentation, and professional live transfers.



Train callers to identify genuine financing needs and distinguish active prospects from contacts who need further follow-up.



Use standardized QA scorecards to evaluate accuracy, listening skills, professionalism, qualification, and handoff quality.



Establish minimum weekly call-review coverage for every caller, supported by live monitoring, individual coaching, and team role-play sessions.



Incorporate loan officer feedback into training so callers understand what makes a transfer useful and what causes prospects to disengage.



Reinforce company-approved scripts, required disclosures, and calling procedures. Ensure callers route rate quotes, eligibility decisions, and loan advice to appropriately licensed personnel.



Set measurable ramp goals for new hires and retrain promptly when scripts, products, or processes change.



Ideal Candidate:



Five or more years of mortgage industry experience required.



Proven experience directly managing mortgage telemarketing or lead generation teams, with the ability to coach and hold 5–10 callers accountable.



Demonstrated success generating qualified live transfers and improving conversion through call review, training, and disciplined follow-up.

Compensation and Schedule



* Starting pay: $6 USD/hour

* Additional performance bonuses based on qualified appointments that attend

* Paid training and evaluation period

* Monday–Friday, 30–40 hours per week

* California daytime and evening calling coverage

* Long-term opportunity with performance-based growth



How to Apply



Applications missing any of the following will not be considered.



Start your application with the word ASCEND.



1. Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your US outbound cold-calling experience.

2. State how many years you’ve worked in US residential solar appointment setting.

Write exactly how you would respond on the phone.

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I will often provide very specific instructions about:



* Avatar appearance

* Clothing

* Store/location

* Camera angles

* Product placement

* Product images

* Dialogue

* Voice

* Editing

* Captions

* Reference videos

* Clip pacing



I need someone who actually reads everything carefully and follows those instructions.



If I say to use a specific reference product, store, avatar, voice, or editing style, I should not have to repeat it several times.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

* Able to quickly correct mistakes



If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Proven hands-on experience with **Veo 3**

* Experience with **Google Flow**

* Experience with **HeyGen**

* Experience with **Grok**

* Strong experience with **Higgsfield**

* Deep familiarity with **Nano Banana 1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro**

* Experience with **ElevenLabs**

* Strong **CapCut** editing skills

* Strong prompt-writing ability

* Ability to maintain consistent AI characters

* Ability to generate realistic product shots

* Ability to recreate reference videos

* Ability to create completely new video concepts from scripts and inspiration

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong attention to realism

* Strong communication

* High output capacity



You must be able to produce **4+ finished videos per day, 5–6 days per week.**



---



# WHEN APPLYING



Please include:



* Examples of AI videos you have personally created

* Examples using Veo 3

* Examples of Nano Banana/Higgsfield image generation

* Examples of realistic AI avatars

* Examples of short-form editing

* Examples showing realistic product placement or product handling if available



Also briefly explain which tools you use most often and your experience with:



**Veo 3, Google Flow, Nano Banana 1/2/Pro, Chatgpt, ElevenLabs, and CapCut.**



Please do not apply if you are still learning these tools.



I am looking for someone who can come in and **produce high-quality content from day one.**

title: Experienced Amazon FBA Sourcing & Operations Partner (Long-Term, Performance-Based Pay
description:

This is my business, and I take it very seriously. I'm looking for an experienced Amazon operator who is better at product sourcing than I am and wants a long-term role where their pay grows as the business grows. I am not hiring a beginner, and I'm not looking for someone who wants to learn on the job.



STEP ONE - READ THIS

Start your reply with the word "ASIN" (A-S-I-N) so I know you read this whole post. If your reply doesn't start with ASIN, you will not hear back from me.



WHO DOES WHAT

- You: sourcing and the back end of the business, every day

- Me: the front end. I handle scaling, partnerships and growth strategy.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find new profitable product leads EVERY DAY, with a minimum of 30% ROI after all fees, checked against price history (not just today's price)

- Source and buy approved products, and ship them to our prep center

- Handle the back end: account violations, IP complaints, appeals, listing issues, inventory and shipment tracking

- Keep our Google Sheets profit tracker accurate (costs, fees, net profit)

- Find replenishable products we can buy again and again

- Send a short weekly report: leads found, products bought, units shipped, profit



REQUIREMENTS (mandatory)

- Proven Amazon FBA experience sourcing products (online or retail arbitrage)

- Strong with SellerAmp (or similar) and Keepa

- Experience handling Amazon violations, ungating and account health

- Hardworking, dependable and honest. Daily communication, on time, every time

- Reliable computer and internet, with overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

- Clear written English



PAY AND TRIAL

- Paid 1-2 week trial. If the trial doesn't show leads that meet 30% ROI and would project at least $1,000 in profit, we part ways.

- Monthly salary of $[X], paid on time via [PayPal/Wise]

- PLUS an extra $20 for every $1,000 in profit the business makes each month. Your pay varies based on performance.

- If all you want is your base salary, go somewhere else. If you want to make $800-$900 or more, this is your opportunity to grow your pay month after month with the work you put in.

- Long-term role, with raises and bigger bonuses as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

Remember: start your reply with "ASIN." Then include:

1. Your years of Amazon FBA experience and what you've sourced or managed

2. The tools you use, and your best results (leads per day, ROI, profit)

3. Three real product leads you'd recommend right now: ASIN, buy cost, sale price and ROI

5. Your availability, time zone and expected monthly pay

title: Molecular Biologist
description:
Opportunity for Filipino applicants | Position in La Paz, Bolivia



MaxPrecision Lab S.R.L. is looking for a person with a scientific background, analytical thinking, clear communication skills, and a strong willingness to learn to contribute to product analysis, scientific documentation, and technical support in molecular biology.

We are a biotechnology-related company based in La Paz, Bolivia, dedicated to the distribution of laboratory materials, supplies, reagents, and specialized products.

We welcome applicants who have studied Biology or related fields, including both those who have specialized in molecular biology and those interested in expanding their knowledge and developing professionally in this area.

Previous professional experience is not required. We value a positive attitude, discipline, scientific curiosity, and the ability to learn and apply new knowledge.



What We Offer



- Job stability and reliable salary payments.

- Opportunities for professional growth and development in a biotechnology-related company.

- Practical experience in projects involving technical analysis, product evaluation, scientific support, and communication of laboratory applications.

- A collaborative environment that values initiative, fast learning, technical accuracy, and problem-solving.

- International work experience and collaboration with a team based in Bolivia.

- The opportunity to work on-site in La Paz or fully remotely.



Main Responsibilities



- Analyze technical data sheets, specifications, protocols, and scientific literature related to products, reagents, and supplies used in molecular biology.

- Prepare comparative tables explaining product characteristics, differences, advantages, limitations, and potential applications.

-  Support the review and documentation of molecular biology procedures, identifying areas that require clarification or improvement.

- Prepare guides, presentations, videos, and other educational materials for training, product demonstrations, and post-sale support, using documentation and records from the laboratory team when appropriate.

- Provide ongoing technical support and help answer customer questions about the use, performance, and applications of molecular biology products.

- Coordinate with the General Manager and technical team to align scientific activities with customer needs and company objectives.

- Learn and use digital and artificial intelligence tools.



Required Profile



- Good command of English.

- Interest in molecular biology, applied scientific work, and continuous learning.

- Analytical ability to compare products, interpret technical information, and develop clear conclusions.

- Responsibility, discipline, organization, and attention to detail.

- Clear oral and written communication skills to explain scientific and technical information.

- A customer-oriented mindset and willingness to provide technical support and create simple, useful educational materials.

- Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new methodologies, tools, and work processes.

- Initiative and willingness to suggest improvements and solve problems.



Preferred Qualifications



- A strong academic record.

- Knowledge of molecular biology and familiarity with techniques such as DNA and RNA extraction, PCR, or electrophoresis.

- Familiarity with reading scientific papers, technical data sheets, and laboratory protocols.

- Academic or personal projects related to this field or to other areas.

- Participation in research, laboratory activities, science fairs, publications, teaching assistant roles, or science communication activities.

- Achievements that demonstrate initiative, perseverance, discipline, learning ability, or commitment.



Tell Us Where You Have Excelled



If you have received recognition or commendations for your performance, graduated with honors or academic distinction, won competitions, medals, or awards, or accomplished something you are proud of, you are welcome to share it in your application.

We are interested in achievements both within and outside your field of study, including academic, professional, scientific, entrepreneurial, sports, or extracurricular activities. Tell us what you achieved, your contribution, and what you learned. You may include certificates, links, or examples of your work if available.



Workplace

Work arrangement: on-site or fully remote.

Office location: MaxPrecision Lab S.R.L., La Paz, Bolivia.

Address: Pasoskanqui Building, Offices 7 and 9, between Pasoskanqui Street and Brasil Avenue, Miraflores, La Paz, Bolivia.

title: Discord Community Moderator & Platform Support (Clipping & Editing Platform)

In your application, tell us about one

title: Director of Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation
description:
Work Arrangement: Remote

Level: Senior Leadership

Industry: Business Operations / Organizational Development / Transformation



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced leader who knows how to make businesses work better.

Your job is to understand how an organization operates, identify what is holding it back, and lead improvements that produce measurable results.

You will work closely with the CEO and department leaders to strengthen business processes, improve team performance, clarify responsibilities, and make sure important changes are successfully implemented.



Your first assignment will focus on improving a multi-location food and beverage business. You will also help the company deliver transformation projects for other clients and develop services that support business growth.



What You'll Do

1. Identify Business Problems

 Review how teams, departments and business processes operate.

 Identify inefficiencies, communication gaps, unclear responsibilities and performance issues.

 Determine the root causes of problems and recommend practical solutions.



2. Improve How the Organization Works

 Improve workflows, management systems and accountability.

 Help leaders establish clear responsibilities, priorities and performance expectations.

 Develop practical plans to improve efficiency and business results.



3. Lead Change and Implementation

 Work with department heads to implement improvements.

 Coordinate projects across different teams and functions.

 Ensure changes are understood, adopted and sustained.

 Monitor progress and resolve obstacles that prevent successful implementation.



4. Measure Business Results

 Use business data and performance indicators to evaluate improvements.

 Track whether changes improve efficiency, productivity, customer experience or profitability.

 Use AI, analytics and digital tools to support better decisions and business processes.



5. Support Client Success and Business Growth

 Understand client challenges and help develop practical solutions.

 Lead or coordinate the implementation of improvement projects for clients.

 Build strong relationships with business leaders and clients.

 Help identify opportunities to turn successful solutions into repeatable services.



What We're Looking For

- Significant leadership experience in organizational effectiveness, business transformation, operations, management consulting or a related field.

 Proven experience identifying business problems and successfully implementing improvements.

 Strong understanding of organizational structures, workflows, leadership and performance management.

 Experience leading cross-functional projects and working with senior executives.

 Ability to analyze business performance and translate findings into practical action.

 Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

 Advanced practical experience using AI and digital tools to improve business processes.

 Experience supporting client relationships, business development or commercial growth.

An advantage, but not required:

 Experience in multi-location businesses, including food and beverage.

 Experience in consulting, client implementation or scaling business services.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful when:

 Business problems are identified and resolved.

 Teams operate with clearer responsibilities and stronger accountability.

 Processes become more efficient and consistent.

 Improvement projects are implemented successfully, not just recommended.

 Business performance improves in measurable ways.

 Clients experience meaningful and lasting results.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?

Someone who enjoys understanding how businesses work, solving complex organizational problems, leading people through change, and turning ideas into real improvements.

We're looking for a leader who doesn't just recommend changes, but makes sure they happen and deliver results.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) for APAC Region
description:
APAC Sales Development Representative 

Philippines-Based | Remote Opportunity

Compensation: 50,000 php per month 



The Company

DTiQ is a leading provider of intelligent video, data analytics, remote audit, and drive-thru performance solutions for multi-unit restaurants, retailers, and convenience stores. Built on more than 25 years of industry leadership, DTiQ’s SaaS platform integrates video, POS and operational data, AI-powered insights, exception management, and expert review to help operators reduce loss, improve execution, and act in real time. Serving more than 32,000 locations and 2,600 clients around the world, DTiQ helps leading brands turn store-level visibility into measurable business outcomes.



We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.



For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (www.
/company/dtiq).



To Apply: 



The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and customer-focused Sales Development Representative for the APAC region to help drive operational excellence across our global Sales organization.  In this role, you will work independently to generate sales opportunities and build sales pipeline to support growth in the APAC region.

• Prospect and engage new customers across APAC through outbound calls,
 and LinkedIn.

• Identify target accounts, key decision-makers and new business opportunities.

• Qualify leads and conduct initial discovery conversations.

• Deliver introductory product demos and present DTiQ’s solutions.

• Build and manage pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining accurate records and follow-ups.

• Convert leads from marketing campaigns, industry events and partner referrals.

• Work closely with regional sales leadership to progress opportunities.



Required Qualifications

• 1–3 years’ experience in sales, business development or lead generation.

• Strong communication, prospecting and relationship-building skills.

• Proactive, results-driven and comfortable with outbound sales.

• B2B technology or SaaS experience is desirable but not essential.



Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting global Sales organizations

• Exposure to SaaS, technology, or multinational environments

• Experience working with distributed or remote teams



Why Join Us?

• Work with a collaborative and globally distributed team

• Exposure to international sales operations and commercial processes

• Opportunity to influence process improvements and operational strategy

• Fast-paced environment with strong career growth potential

• High-impact role supporting revenue-driving teams

• Culture that values teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement



HOW TO APPLY

As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



Application Link: 



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity, but allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day to day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. Your formal contract will come from Ripping and DTiQ will manager your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.

title: WANTED! Ambitious Head of Production & Sourcing | Custom Apparel & Promo Products
description:
*Run Your Own Department · Make an Impact at a Stable and Growing Company*

*Starts at $2,000 USD/month + Bonuses · 15 Paid Days Off*

*Full-time · Remote · Monday–Friday, 10AM-7PM Eastern Time*



WHO WE ARE

Hot Print Co makes custom apparel and promotional products for organizations across the US: colleges, companies, churches, camps, and more. We’ve been in business for more than a decade and have served thousands of organizations.



We’re a small global team with big ambitions. We don’t do layers of management or bureaucracy. We hire great people. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility, judged on results instead of hours, and paid more as your impact grows.



We’re scaling aggressively and staying lean. That means every person here matters, and every win is visible.



Check us out: 



ROLE

You own everything between an order being sold and it arriving at the customer’s door. Every order we sell is produced by a growing network of outside decorators and vendors. You work with them to make sure every order arrives correct, on time, and at the lowest possible cost.



Being responsible for every order does not mean processing orders by hand forever. That manual, routine work is being automated away so your time goes to strategic improvements.



Most of the time, when nothing is on fire, you’re finding cheaper ways to deliver the same products, and tightening our processes so mistakes don’t happen.



But sometimes, you get to jump in and be the hero! That might mean catching a problem before it costs us anything. Or rectifying a problem that already happened.



You report to our incredible Operations Manager and collaborate with her on interdepartmental decisions.



WHAT YOU OWN

- Production health: Keep every order moving. When issues surface, you solve them in real time.

- Cost and profit: For every order and expense, find money we’re leaving on the table and bring it home. Better rates, smarter sourcing, less waste. The opportunities are endless.

- The vendor network: Build a network of decorators and suppliers with the right capabilities, coverage, and pricing. Negotiate prices, set clear standards, and replace vendors as needed.

- Systems: Reduce mistakes. Automate what can be automated. Delete steps that don’t need to exist.

- Getting the order there, even when it seems impossible: A lost package. A hurricane. A critical art error. The customer still needs their order tomorrow. Most people say it can’t be done. You’re the one who finds a way.

- Being the expert everyone relies on: When the art team needs to know what a decorator can do, they come to you. When sales is quoting a product they’ve never seen, they come to you.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You have in-depth knowledge of garments, decoration methods, and promotional products.

- You catch the smallest detail without losing sight of the big picture.

- Your written and spoken English is excellent. You’ll work directly with US vendors, including on the phone, with no hesitation.

- You use AI and technology to multiply your output. You’re the brain, not the hands.

- You have a quiet workspace with reliable power and internet.



WHAT YOU GET

- $24,000 USD per year to start, paid every two weeks through Wise.

- Annual bonus and raise.

- Extra bonuses and raises tied to the money you save us. Get a share of verified savings.

- 15 paid days off per year. And we are flexible.

- Your own department. Real decisions, real authority. No one micromanages you.

- A company that keeps its people. Our longest-serving team member has been here 7+ years.

- Room to grow. As production volume grows, your scope, your team, and your pay grow with it.

- Impact. What you do here is measurable and matters.

- You’re treated like a leader, not an assistant.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE

- Orders arrive correct and ahead of deadline.

- Production costs keep dropping without trading away quality or reliability.

- The vendor network gets broader, more competitive, and less dependent on any single vendor.

- We handle more orders without more manual work.

- Gross profit rises, and everyone can point to why.



OUR VALUES

Our mission is to build and empower a championship-level team that is proud of the work they do and how they do it. We live and die by these values. If you don’t have them, you won’t be successful here.



Championship Mindset. You prepare thoroughly, execute consistently, and hold your standard when nobody is watching. You define excellence instead of waiting to be told, and you keep raising your own bar. “Good enough” isn’t in your vocabulary.



Extreme Ownership. You own outcomes, not tasks. When something goes wrong, you ask what you could have done differently. You bring solutions, not just problems. No blame, no excuses.



Speed with Direction. You prioritize what matters most, then move fast. Act, learn, adjust. Problems get solved while they’re fresh.



Straightforward Communication. You say it clearly, early, and directly, including when it’s uncomfortable. You take feedback without taking it personally.



IS THIS RIGHT FOR YOU?

This role is not for everyone. Make sure you’re comfortable with:



- Holding vendors accountable. Calling them, pushing back, renegotiating, and sometimes dropping a vendor you like. If confrontation makes you uncomfortable, this will be hard.

- Solving problems you’ve never seen before. We don’t have playbooks for every scenario. Problems land on you, and your job is to solve them, not hand them off to someone else.

- Constant change. Our tools and processes change often because we’re automating fast.

- Being judged on numbers. We measure cost, on-time rate, and errors. Effort is great, but results are what count.

- Being a one-person department. The team scales with the work.

- Ramping up fast. The department runs smoothly today, and there’s a lot of room to make it better. Improvements start in your first week, not your sixth month.



If that list makes you excited instead of nervous, keep reading.



TO APPLY

If you are interested, please submit the following:



1. A link to your resume in PDF format named: Lastname.Firstname.Production.pdf

2. Details of your relevant experience, the results you produced, and why you would be a good fit.

3. 2-3 questions you’d want answered before taking this role.



We prefer
 submissions.

Submissions should go to: 

Use this exact subject line: "I solve problems"



We will respond to your submissions within 48 hours with next steps. Top candidates should expect an interview and paid trial task.



----------------------------------------



This function needs an exceptional owner, and we know that person is not easy to find. If that’s you — if you’ve done work like this, produced extreme results, and want this level of ownership — we want to hear from you.



If anything about the role or the instructions isn’t clear, don’t hesitate to reach out. We are happy to answer any questions!

title: Calling Associate – Apartment Community Data Team
description:
Location: Remote

Schedule: Full-time

Team: The Dwelling Collection



The Dwelling Collection is looking for a friendly, organized Calling Associate to help us keep apartment community information accurate and up to date.



Our agents rely on current information to confidently recommend communities to their clients. In this role, you’ll call apartment communities, speak with leasing teams, and collect the details our agents need to make informed recommendations and successfully register their clients.



If you enjoy conversations, ask good questions, and take pride in keeping information organized, this could be a great fit.

What you’ll do

- Call apartment communities across the markets where we operate and introduce yourself as a member of The Dwelling Collection’s data team.

- Confirm and update community information in Kindly OS, our internal platform.

- Ask leasing teams about current availability, pricing, concessions, and other details relevant to renters.

- Confirm whether communities work with apartment locators or real estate agents and whether they pay a referral commission.

- Collect or verify details about commission amounts, registration requirements, guest card procedures, and required documents.

- Verify the best phone number and
 address for future community communication.

- Document each conversation clearly, including the date, the person you spoke with, what was confirmed, and any follow-up needed.

title: Linux / Cloud Engineer (Work from home)
description:
Hello!



We are seeking a Linux guru to work remotely from home on a full-time basis. 



Your Primary Role would be supporting the deployment and upgrades of an enterprise software application to self-hosted environments of various clients. This would primarily be a consulting role to clients.



You would be interfacing with our clients over Zoom Video calls providing remote guided assistance to ensure their self-hosted environment meets certain specifications and perform software installation and/or version upgrades within the client’s cloud environment.



This role requires that you are customer-facing, so you will need to be;

- be very confident in front of customers

- be very professional and present concepts well to customers

- be a great troubleshooter

- be an expert in Linux

- good familiarity with Kubernetes and KOTS (Kubernetes Off-The-Shelf)



The key is that you have great troubleshooting skills as sometimes the deployments require some level of creativity.



Our job is to ensure that the client’s software is installed/upgraded and to pave a path to remove the roadblocks for a successful deployment. In this role, you must be extremely comfortable installing and configuring common Linux distributions (eg Ubuntu RedHat etc).



Secondary Role:

Your Secondary Role would be help manage and automate our private cloud hosting environment to drive operational efficiency. We develop and manage our own SaaS AI application as well as integrate AI with 3rd party applications which are hosted in our environment.



This would include:

• Deploying/provisioning servers

• Testing applications and performance

• Automating cloud processes



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

You MUST have good experience with:

• Windows and Linux (ideally Ubuntu) server deployment/administration

• Docker and Kubernetes / KOTS

• Gitlab

• Automation (Microsoft Windows automation, SALT, Terraform, PXE Booting, Ubuntu Autoinstaller, Cloud-Init etc)

• Networking skills (IP addressing, subnetting, firewalls, routing/switching, DNS, etc)

• Cloud infrastructure (virtualization - Proxmox/VMware – deploying/managing cloud environments)

• Python/Scripting

• Data Analytics/SQL



ABOUT US:

We are a small technology solutions company in the USA offering private cloud hosting, enterprise software readiness and deployment, managed IT services, AI integrations, and SaaS services.



WE INVEST IN YOU:

We hire with the intent that you would become part of our team for the long-term. We are a very small company with a fairly fast-paced environment and can offer incredible opportunity for career growth in tech and access to learn about the newest technologies, private cloud and AI.



OUR AUDIENCE:

Our audience is Americans….. So you would need to have EXCELLENT spoken English skills (without a discernable accent), plus very good written/grammar skills.



WORK SCHEDULE:

The work week schedule would be something like:

Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 5:00pm Central Standard Time USA.

Some weekend work may be requested at times.

** Please do not apply if you are not available during this work window. **



INTERVIEW:

An online phone interview will be required via Zoom.



To be considered, please forward:

• Your resume (PDF format or link to Google drive preferred)

• A paragraph or so about yourself that discusses your level of experience in each of the technical required areas.

• Your level of spoken English (please send an audio file link/video link of your English speaking skills if you have one)

• Your desired compensation – this is very important. Resumes will not be considered without it.



COMPENSATION:

You would be paid on an hourly basis. We would expect 40 hours per week worked. Compensation will be d
 on your overall experience and value.

We are looking for detail-oriented people. When you reply, include “GOOFY” in the subject so we know you actually read this.

title: Female Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote / Work From Home



About Us



We are a fast-growing, USA-based digital marketing company focused on helping businesses grow through digital strategies, online content, and modern marketing technologies.



We are building a team of ambitious, tech-savvy professionals who take initiative, move quickly, and deliver results. We believe in efficiency, innovation, and using AI-powered tools to streamline workflows and maximize productivity.



We are looking for a sharp, proactive Virtual Assistant who is passionate about technology, understands the power of digital content, and is ready to contribute to a growing business.



The Role



We are looking for a highly organized, creative, and tech-savvy female Virtual Assistant who can help us research content, discover trending topics, use AI tools, and publish videos across digital platforms.



This is not a passive administrative role. We need someone who takes ownership, works independently, solves problems, and consistently gets things done without needing to be micromanaged.



The ideal candidate is curious, fast-learning, detail-oriented, and comfortable experimenting with new tools and technologies to improve productivity.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Tools & Automation

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other productivity platforms to support daily operations.

Generate content ideas, research topics, organize information, and assist with content creation.

Use AI to improve efficiency, reduce repetitive work, and streamline workflows.

Learn new AI tools quickly and identify opportunities to improve existing processes.

2. Content Hunting & Research

Find trending topics, viral videos, engaging posts, and high-performing content relevant to our target audience.

Research competitors, social media accounts, industry trends, and content opportunities.

Identify content that can be adapted into original posts, short-form videos, and marketing assets.

Maintain organized content research documents, links, and reference libraries.

Bring fresh ideas to the team instead of waiting for instructions.

3. Video Posting & Social Media Management

Upload and publish videos across assigned social media platforms.

Prepare captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, and other publishing details.

Schedule content using available social media management tools.

Ensure videos are uploaded with the correct formatting, thumbnails, captions, and publishing settings.

Follow content calendars and maintain a consistent posting schedule.

Monitor published content and report basic performance metrics.

4. Content Organization & Quality Control

Organize videos, images, links, captions, and project files.

Maintain spreadsheets, task trackers, and content calendars.

Double-check all content before publishing to prevent errors.

Follow brand guidelines, instructions, and standard operating procedures.

Keep the team updated on completed tasks, pending work, and potential issues.

5. Proactive Support & Execution

Take ownership of assigned projects from start to finish.

Identify problems and suggest practical solutions.

Meet deadlines without constant reminders.

Communicate clearly and provide regular progress updates.

Look for ways to improve content quality, workflow efficiency, and overall productivity.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Excellent written English and strong communication skills.

Strong computer skills and genuine interest in technology.

Hands-on familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

Understanding of social media platforms and short-form video content.

Ability to research trends and identify engaging content.

Comfortable uploading, scheduling, and organizing digital content.

Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

Ability to multitask, prioritize work, and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup.

Ability to learn new software quickly and work independently.

A proactive, accountable, and solutions-oriented mindset.



Preferred but not required:



Experience with Canva, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.

Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
, or other social platforms.

Experience with social media scheduling tools.

Basic knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, or content strategy.

A portfolio or examples of previous content-related work.

The Type of Person We Want



We are looking for a professional who is:



Proactive: You take action instead of waiting to be told every small step.

Tech-savvy: You enjoy exploring AI tools, software, and new technologies.

Fast and efficient: You work quickly without sacrificing quality.

Resourceful: You know how to research, troubleshoot, and find answers independently.

Detail-oriented: You check your work and take pride in accuracy.

Accountable: You meet deadlines, communicate honestly, and take responsibility for results.

Growth-minded: You want to improve your skills and grow alongside a successful company.



If you need constant supervision, struggle to learn new tools, or wait for instructions before taking action, this role will not be the right fit.



What We Offer

The opportunity to work with a growing USA-based digital marketing company.

Remote work and a professional international team environment.

Exposure to modern AI tools, content workflows, and digital marketing.

Opportunities to develop valuable technical and creative skills.

Potential for long-term growth based on performance and contribution.

How to Apply



To be considered, please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

A list of AI tools you have used and how you use them.

The social media platforms you have experience working with.

Details of your experience with video posting, content research, Canva, or CapCut.

Your computer specifications and internet connection details.

Links to examples of your previous work, if available.

Your expected monthly salary and availability to start.

Mandatory Application Test



To demonstrate that you have read the entire job description, begin your application with the words "AI Content Pro."



Also answer this question in 3–5 sentences:



If you were asked to find 10 trending video ideas for a digital marketing company, what steps and AI tools would you use to complete the task efficiently?



Applications that follow all instructions and demonstrate practical knowledge, initiative, and strong attention to detail will receive priority.



We are looking for someone who wants to do more than simply complete tasks. We want a driven professional who can help us move faster, work smarter, and grow with the business.



If you are tech-savvy, resourceful, and ready to take ownership, we want to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
Fraser & Co. (the Michelle Fraser Team) is a boutique real estate team in Pickering, Ontario, Canada, operating under RE/MAX Hallmark Fraser Group Realty. We represent sellers, buyers, landlords and tenants across Durham Region and the Greater Toronto Area. The team was founded by Michelle Fraser, who brings more than 25 years in the market.



We are hiring a full-time listing and transaction coordinator for our Client Care team. You will run the paperwork and systems side of our transactions and report to our Client Care Manager. This is a long-term role. Transaction coordination is the core of the job, and the scope will change as the business grows. We want someone who adapts quickly and is comfortable taking on new systems and tasks.



THE STANDARD

Accurate paperwork and timely follow-through protect our clients and keep deals moving. Before you submit anything for review, check it against the approved source documents.



Done right means:

- The correct, current form or template for the transaction and the side we represent

- Every name, contact detail, property fact, price, date and deadline checked against the source

- Showing instructions entered exactly as the seller gave them

- Missing, conflicting or unclear information flagged right away, never guessed

- No file marked complete while a required document is outstanding



Agents review documents before anything is signed. That review is a second check, not your first.



SCHEDULE

- Monday to Friday, flexible hours between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM Toronto time: 7 paid hours total per day

- On-call outside the shift for time-sensitive offer and deadline work. On-call time worked is paid at your hourly rate. We explain how on-call works during the interview stage.



PAY

- CAD $6 (USD$4.25) to $8 (USD$5.7) per hour, based on experience

- Paid in Canadian dollars, twice a month. The USD figure above is approximate and moves with the exchange rate.

- Your rate is reviewed based on performance



WHAT YOU GET

- A long-term, full-time position

- A direct manager and written workflows (SOPs) to work from

- Training on Ontario forms, our systems and our standards

- Room to grow as the role and the business expand



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build MLS listings in PropTx Realm from our intake forms, GeoWarehouse reports and past listings, and submit them once approved. Update open houses and set up showings in BrokerBay exactly as the seller directs.

- Prepare listing agreements, amendments and listing packages in DocuSign from approved templates and agent instructions. Agents approve every document before it goes for signature.

- Prepare offer summaries and track conditions, deposits and deadlines on every deal

- Keep every SkySlope compliance file complete under our brokerage procedures: FINTRAC ID forms, deposit receipts, receipt of funds, lawyer details and commission

- Update Follow Up Boss (client details, deal stages, data clean-up, follow-up lists), Sisu, and our listing and sales trackers

- Prepare open house info sheets, and set up and file transaction folders in Google Drive

- Work the Client Care inbox: request missing documents from our agents and cooperating brokerages, and draft client
s for our team to send. You will not contact clients directly.

- Use AI tools inside our written workflows, and check every output against the source

- Protect client information. You will handle ID documents, contracts and personal data, and must follow our rules on system access, document handling and what may be entered into AI tools.

- Take on other administrative and operations work as the needs of the business change



MUST HAVE

- Prior real estate admin or transaction coordination experience. We train you on Ontario forms and our workflows, not on real estate basics.

- Hands-on experience entering listings into an MLS system

- Experience preparing real estate forms and sending them through DocuSign

- CRM experience

- Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive and Sheets

- Clear, accurate written English

- Primary internet plus a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet workspace with a webcam and headset

- Full availability for the schedule above



NICE TO HAVE

- Ontario experience: OREA forms, PropTx Realm or TRREB MLS, FINTRAC records

- Follow Up Boss, SkySlope, BrokerBay, ClickUp

- Regular use of AI tools in your work



HOW TO APPLY

We review complete applications only. Following instructions exactly is part of this job. Applications are text only, so send links, not files.



1. Use this subject line: Transaction Coordinator | Your Full Name | Years in Real Estate Admin

2. Start your message with the word IRREVOCABLE.

3. Resume (required): paste a link to your resume. Google Drive or Dropbox is fine. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" and check that the link opens.

4. Work samples (optional): paste links to public listings you entered (MLS, 
, Zillow or similar), or to blank templates, checklists, trackers or SOPs you built. Do not share anything that shows client names, ID documents or contract details.

5. Answer the five questions below in your own words. Label your answers Q1 to Q5 and keep each one to 2 to 4 sentences.



QUESTIONS

Q1. Tell us about your real estate experience: the markets or countries you supported, the work you handled, and the systems you used.

Q2. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. How was it found, and what did you change afterward?

Q3. Tell us about a time your role or priorities changed quickly. How did you adapt?

Q4. What other clients or jobs do you have right now, and how many hours a week do they take?

Q5. Can you work flexibly between 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM Toronto time, Monday to Friday, plus paid on-call time? What hourly rate within the posted range do you expect, and why? What is your earliest start date?

title: AI Operations and Email Automation Specialist
description:
We're looking for a hands-on operator who can build better systems and manage client
 automation. You should be comfortable turning a recurring task into a clear, tested process, using AI to reduce manual work, and checking that the finished work actually functions.



The main focus is operations and client
 flows. Related administrative support may be part of the role, but this is a specialist position, not a general VA or AI image-generation role.



What you will do

• Map recurring tasks, identify what can be simplified or automated, and build practical workflows with clear owners and approval steps.

• Create SOPs, checklists, and short walkthroughs that someone else can follow.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot client
 campaigns and automated flows, with Klaviyo a priority. Learn client platforms such as Zenoti and LoyalSnap, including
 and SMS where relevant.

• Work with approved templates and copy. Check audience segments, triggers, filters, timing, personalization, links, UTM tracking, and desktop/mobile presentation before anything goes live.

• Connect tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, Shopify, and
 platforms using Zapier, Make, or n8n.

• Use AI for research, drafting, information extraction, reporting, and documentation. Verify its output and keep confidential information within approved tools.

• Test what you build, confirm changes are saved, prevent duplicate actions, investigate failures, and keep a clear record of what is complete or blocked.

What you need

• Examples of operational workflows you personally built and maintained, plus hands-on experience running
 campaigns or automated flows.

• Practical experience with at least one automation platform: Zapier, Make, or n8n. Strong Klaviyo experience is a significant advantage.

• Confidence working in Notion and Google Workspace, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems without guessing.

• Good written English, careful quality checks, and the judgment to ask for approval before sending, publishing, or making consequential account changes.

• The ability to manage separate client accounts, follow brand instructions, and protect client data.



Helpful extras

Shopify, Zenoti or LoyalSnap experience; basic
 HTML/CSS; APIs and webhooks; troubleshooting integrations and reporting on
 performance.



How to apply



Include:

1. A short introduction explaining why this combination of operations and
 work fits you.

2. Two relevant examples: one workflow or system and one
 flow or campaign. Explain what you personally built, the tools used, how you tested it, and the result. Redacted screenshots, a short walkthrough, or a safe demo are welcome. Do not share confidential client information.

3. One example of an automation that failed and how you diagnosed and fixed it.

4. The AI and automation tools you use regularly, your availability and time zone, and your expected rate.

We're most interested in working systems, careful execution, and clear documentation.
